## bakery-service · GlobalExceptionHandler.handleValidation

Nguồn: [GlobalExceptionHandler.java:50](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java#L50). Kiểu trả về `ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Map<String, String>>>`.

```java
@ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Map<String, String>>> handleValidation(MethodArgumentNotValidException exception)
{
        Map<String, String> errors = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        exception.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors()
                .forEach(error -> errors.putIfAbsent(error.getField(), error.getDefaultMessage()));
        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                .body(ApiResponse.of(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(), "Validation failed", errors));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@RestControllerAdvice`

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public AddOnDto create(UUID bakeryId, AddOnDto request)
{
        rejectId(request);
        Bakery bakery = findBakery(bakeryId);
        String name = required(request.name(), "name");
        String category = required(request.category(), "category");
        BigDecimal price = requiredPrice(request.price());
        AddOn addOn = new AddOn(bakery, name, category, price);
        addOn.update(null, request.description(), null, null, request.active());
        return AddOnDto.fromEntity(addOnRepository.saveAndFlush(addOn));
    }
```

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public AddOnDto update(UUID bakeryId, UUID addOnId, AddOnDto request)
{
        rejectId(request);
        AddOn addOn = addOnRepository.findByIdAndBakery_Id(addOnId, bakeryId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Add-on not found"));
        addOn.update(request.name() == null ? null : required(request.name(), "name"),
                request.description(),
                request.category() == null ? null : required(request.category(), "category"),
                request.price() == null ? null : requiredPrice(request.price()), request.active());
        addOnRepository.flush();
        return AddOnDto.fromEntity(addOn);
    }
```

## bakery-service · AddOnServiceImpl.uploadImage

Nguồn: [AddOnServiceImpl.java:80](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/addon/service/impl/AddOnServiceImpl.java#L80). Kiểu trả về `MediaResponse`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public MediaResponse uploadImage(UUID bakeryId, UUID addOnId, MultipartFile file)
{
        AddOn addOn = addOnRepository.findByIdAndBakery_Id(addOnId, bakeryId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Add-on not found"));
        BakeryImageStorage.StoredImage image = imageStorage.upload(file,
                "bakeries/" + bakeryId + "/add-ons/" + addOnId);
        String url = imageStorage.signedUrl(image.objectKey());
        String oldKey = addOn.getImageObjectKey();
        addOn.replaceImage(image.objectKey());
        addOnRepository.flush();
        imageStorage.afterCommitDelete(oldKey);
        return new MediaResponse(url, Instant.now().plus(imageStorage.urlExpiry()));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

```java
public void submitForApproval()
{
        if (status != BakeryStatus.DRAFT) throw new IllegalStateException("Only a draft bakery can be submitted");
        status = BakeryStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL;
```

## bakery-service · Bakery.changeStatus

Nguồn: [Bakery.java:82](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/bakery/entity/Bakery.java#L82). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
public void changeStatus(BakeryStatus target)
{
        boolean allowed = switch (target) {
            case ACTIVE -> status == BakeryStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL || status == BakeryStatus.SUSPENDED;
            case DRAFT -> status == BakeryStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL;
            case SUSPENDED -> status == BakeryStatus.ACTIVE;
            case CLOSED -> status != BakeryStatus.CLOSED;
            case PENDING_APPROVAL -> false;
        };
        if (!allowed) throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid bakery status transition");
        status = target;
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Entity`, `@Table(name = "bakeries")`

```java
public AdminBakeryDetailResponse detail(UUID bakeryId)
{
        var bakery = bakeryService.get(bakeryId);
        var members = memberService.list(bakeryId);
        AdminBakeryDetailResponse.SubscriptionSummary subscription;
        try {
            var entitlement = entitlementClient.getEntitlement(bakeryId);
            subscription = new AdminBakeryDetailResponse.SubscriptionSummary(
                    entitlement.active(), entitlement.planCode(), entitlement.periodEnd(),
                    entitlement.features());
        } catch (AppException exception) {
            if (exception.getStatus() != HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE) throw exception;
            subscription = null;
        }
        return new AdminBakeryDetailResponse(bakery, members, subscription);
    }
```

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public BakeryInternalProfileResponse profile(UUID bakeryId)
{
        var bakery = bakeryRepository.findById(bakeryId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Bakery not found"));
        var primaryAddress = addressRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakeryId).stream()
                .filter(address -> address.isPrimary()).findFirst()
                .map(address -> new BakeryInternalProfileResponse.Address(
                        address.getDistrict(), address.getCity())).orElse(null);
        var areas = areaRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakeryId).stream()
                .map(area -> new BakeryInternalProfileResponse.Area(area.getDistrict(),
                        area.getCity(), area.getDeliveryFee(), area.isActive())).toList();
        return new BakeryInternalProfileResponse(bakeryId, bakery.getName(), bakery.getStatus(),
                primaryAddress, areas);
    }
```

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public BakeryAuthorizationResponse authorization(UUID bakeryId, UUID userId,
            BakeryMemberRole requiredRole)
{
        if (!bakeryRepository.existsById(bakeryId)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Bakery not found");
        }
        return memberRepository.findByBakery_IdAndUserId(bakeryId, userId)
                .map(member -> {
                    boolean active = member.getStatus() == BakeryMemberStatus.ACTIVE
                            && member.getMemberRole() == BakeryMemberRole.OWNER;
                    boolean authorized = active && (requiredRole == null
                            || member.getMemberRole() == requiredRole);
                    return new BakeryAuthorizationResponse(bakeryId, userId, active,
                            member.getMemberRole(), authorized);
                })
                .orElse(new BakeryAuthorizationResponse(bakeryId, userId, false, null, false));
    }
```

## bakery-service · BakeryOnboardingServiceImpl.submit

Nguồn: [BakeryOnboardingServiceImpl.java:47](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/bakery/service/impl/BakeryOnboardingServiceImpl.java#L47). Kiểu trả về `BakeryDto`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public BakeryDto submit(UUID customerId, BakeryOnboardingRequest request)
{
        if (!members.tryLockOnboarding(customerId)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "An onboarding request is already in progress");
        }
        BakeryDto bakery = get(customerId);
        if (bakery != null && bakery.status() != BakeryStatus.DRAFT) {
            return bakery;
        }
        BakeryDto profile = request.profile();
        BakeryDto draft = bakery == null ? bakeries.createForOnboarding(profile, customerId)
                : bakeries.update(bakery.id(), profile);
        bakeries.replaceOperations(draft.id(), request.operations());
        return bakeries.submitForApproval(draft.id());
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## bakery-service · BakeryOnboardingServiceImpl.reconcileActivation

Nguồn: [BakeryOnboardingServiceImpl.java:85](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/bakery/service/impl/BakeryOnboardingServiceImpl.java#L85). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
@Override
    public void reconcileActivation(UUID bakeryId)
{
        for (BakeryMember member : members.findPendingActivations(bakeryId, BakeryStatus.ACTIVE,
                BakeryMemberStatus.ACTIVE)) {
            try {
                var roles = identity.getUser(member.getUserId()).roles();
                if (roles != null && roles.contains("BAKERY_OWNER")) {
                    members.markOwnerActivationComplete(member.getId());
                } else if (roles != null && roles.contains("CUSTOMER") && subscriptions.hasActiveSubscription(bakeryId)) {
                    grantOwner(member);
                }
            } catch (AppException failure) {
                log.warn("Owner activation for bakery {} will be retried: {}", bakeryId, failure.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## bakery-service · BakeryServiceImpl.createBakery

Nguồn: [BakeryServiceImpl.java:80](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/bakery/service/impl/BakeryServiceImpl.java#L80). Kiểu trả về `BakeryDto`.

```java
private BakeryDto createBakery(BakeryDto request, UUID ownerUserId, boolean onboarding)
{
        rejectServerFields(request);
        if (ownerUserId == null) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Owner user ID is required");
        }
        String name = required(request.name(), "name");
        String phoneNumber = required(request.phoneNumber(), "phoneNumber");
        var owner = onboarding ? identityUserClient.getUser(ownerUserId) : identityUserClient.requireOwner(ownerUserId);
        if (onboarding && (owner.roles() == null || !owner.roles().contains("CUSTOMER"))) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Customer role is required");
        }
        Bakery bakery = new Bakery(name, phoneNumber, normalized(request.email()));
        bakery.updateProfile(null, request.description(), null, null);
        bakeryRepository.saveAndFlush(bakery);
        BakeryMember member = new BakeryMember(bakery, ownerUserId, BakeryMemberRole.OWNER, owner.displayName());
        if (onboarding) {
            member.requestOwnerActivation();
        }
        bakeryMemberRepository.save(member);
        return toDto(bakery);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## bakery-service · BakeryServiceImpl.submitForApproval

Nguồn: [BakeryServiceImpl.java:137](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/bakery/service/impl/BakeryServiceImpl.java#L137). Kiểu trả về `BakeryDto`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public BakeryDto submitForApproval(UUID bakeryId)
{
        Bakery bakery = findBakery(bakeryId);
        if (bakery.getStatus() != BakeryStatus.DRAFT) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Only a draft bakery can be submitted");
        }
        boolean hasPrimaryAddress = addressRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakeryId).stream()
                .anyMatch(BakeryAddress::isPrimary);
        boolean hasActiveArea = serviceAreaRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakeryId).stream()
                .anyMatch(ServiceArea::isActive);
        if (bakery.getName().isBlank() || bakery.getPhoneNumber().isBlank()
                || !hasPrimaryAddress || !hasActiveArea) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Bakery profile is incomplete");
        }
        bakery.submitForApproval();
        bakeryRepository.flush();
        return toDto(bakery);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

Nguồn: [BakeryServiceImpl.java:157](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/bakery/service/impl/BakeryServiceImpl.java#L157). Kiểu trả về `BakeryDto`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public BakeryDto changeStatus(UUID bakeryId, BakeryStatus status)
{
        if (status == null) throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "status is required");
        Bakery bakery = findBakery(bakeryId);
        if (status == BakeryStatus.ACTIVE && bakery.getStatus() == BakeryStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL) {
            boolean ready = addressRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakeryId).stream()
                    .anyMatch(BakeryAddress::isPrimary)
                    && serviceAreaRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakeryId).stream()
                    .anyMatch(ServiceArea::isActive);
            if (!ready) throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Approval checklist is incomplete");
        }
        try {
            bakery.changeStatus(status);
        } catch (IllegalStateException exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, exception.getMessage());
        }
        bakeryRepository.flush();
        return toDto(bakery);
    }
```

```java
@Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResult<BakeryDto> listForAdmin(BakeryStatus status, String query, String city,
            int page, int size, String sort)
{
        if (page < 1 || size < 1 || size > 100) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "page must be >= 1 and size must be 1..100");
        }
        Sort ordering = AllowedSort.parse(sort, Set.of("name", "createdAt", "id"));
        if (city == null || city.isBlank()) {
            return PageResult.fromPage(bakeryRepository.search(status, query == null ? "" : query.trim(),
                    PageRequest.of(page - 1, size, ordering))
                    .map(this::toDto));
        }
        long count = 0;
        long offset = (long) (page - 1) * size;
        List<BakeryDto> result = new ArrayList<>();
        int chunk = 0;
        org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Bakery> candidates;
        do {
            candidates = bakeryRepository.search(status, query == null ? "" : query.trim(),
                    PageRequest.of(chunk++, 100, ordering));
            for (Bakery bakery : candidates.getContent()) {
                boolean matchesCity = addressRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakery.getId()).stream()
                        .anyMatch(address -> address.getCity().equalsIgnoreCase(city.trim()));
                if (!matchesCity) continue;
                if (count >= offset && result.size() < size) result.add(toDto(bakery));
                count++;
            }
        } while (candidates.hasNext());
        return new PageResult<>(new PageResult.Meta(page, size,
                (int) ((count + size - 1) / size), count), result);
    }
```

## bakery-service · BakeryServiceImpl.validateOperations

Nguồn: [BakeryServiceImpl.java:262](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/bakery/service/impl/BakeryServiceImpl.java#L262). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
private void validateOperations(BakeryOperationsDto request)
{
        if (request == null || request.addresses() == null
                || request.serviceAreas() == null || request.businessHours() == null) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "All operation lists are required");
        }
        long primaryCount = request.addresses().stream()
                .filter(address -> Boolean.TRUE.equals(address.isPrimary())).count();
        if (primaryCount > 1) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Only one primary address is allowed");
        }
        Set<String> areaKeys = new HashSet<>();
        for (BakeryOperationsDto.ServiceArea area : request.serviceAreas()) {
            String key = required(area.city(), "city").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) + "\u0000"
                    + required(area.district(), "district").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!areaKeys.add(key)) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Duplicate service area");
            }
        }
        Set<Short> days = new HashSet<>();
        for (BakeryOperationsDto.BusinessHour hour : request.businessHours()) {
            if (hour.dayOfWeek() == null || hour.dayOfWeek() < 1 || hour.dayOfWeek() > 7
                    || !days.add(hour.dayOfWeek())) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Business days must be unique and between 1 and 7");
            }
            if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(hour.closed()) && (hour.opensAt() == null
                    || hour.closesAt() == null || !hour.opensAt().isBefore(hour.closesAt()))) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Opening time must be before closing time");
            }
        }
    }
```

## bakery-service · BakeryServiceImpl.replaceAddresses

Nguồn: [BakeryServiceImpl.java:293](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/bakery/service/impl/BakeryServiceImpl.java#L293). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
private void replaceAddresses(Bakery bakery, List<BakeryOperationsDto.Address> requested)
{
        Map<UUID, BakeryAddress> existing = new HashMap<>();
        for (BakeryAddress address : addressRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakery.getId())) {
            existing.put(address.getId(), address);
        }
        verifyIds(requested.stream().map(BakeryOperationsDto.Address::id).toList(), existing.keySet());
        Set<UUID> retained = new HashSet<>();
        requested.stream().map(BakeryOperationsDto.Address::id)
                .filter(id -> id != null).forEach(retained::add);
        List<BakeryAddress> removed = existing.values().stream()
                .filter(address -> !retained.contains(address.getId())).toList();
        addressRepository.deleteAll(removed);
        addressRepository.flush();

        // Clear the old primary first so the partial unique index permits a new primary.
        existing.values().stream().filter(address -> retained.contains(address.getId()))
                .forEach(BakeryAddress::clearPrimary);
        addressRepository.flush();

        List<BakeryAddress> saved = new ArrayList<>();
        for (BakeryOperationsDto.Address item : requested) {
            BakeryAddress address = item.id() == null
                    ? new BakeryAddress(bakery, item.addressLine().trim(), item.district().trim(), item.city().trim())
                    : existing.get(item.id());
            address.update(item.addressLine().trim(), normalized(item.ward()), item.district().trim(),
                    item.city().trim(), item.latitude(), item.longitude(), Boolean.TRUE.equals(item.isPrimary()));
            saved.add(address);
        }
        addressRepository.saveAll(saved);
    }
```

```java
private void replaceBusinessHours(Bakery bakery, List<BakeryOperationsDto.BusinessHour> requested)
{
        Map<Short, BusinessHour> existing = new HashMap<>();
        for (BusinessHour hour : businessHourRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakery.getId())) {
            existing.put(hour.getDayOfWeek(), hour);
        }
        Set<Short> retained = new HashSet<>();
        requested.forEach(hour -> retained.add(hour.dayOfWeek()));
        businessHourRepository.deleteAll(existing.values().stream()
                .filter(hour -> !retained.contains(hour.getDayOfWeek())).toList());
        businessHourRepository.flush();
        List<BusinessHour> saved = new ArrayList<>();
        for (BakeryOperationsDto.BusinessHour item : requested) {
            BusinessHour hour = existing.get(item.dayOfWeek());
            if (hour == null) {
                hour = new BusinessHour(bakery, item.dayOfWeek(), item.opensAt(), item.closesAt(),
                        Boolean.TRUE.equals(item.closed()));
            } else {
                hour.update(item.opensAt(), item.closesAt(), Boolean.TRUE.equals(item.closed()));
            }
            saved.add(hour);
        }
        businessHourRepository.saveAll(saved);
    }
```

```java
private static void verifyIds(List<UUID> requestedIds, Set<UUID> ownedIds)
{
        Set<UUID> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (UUID id : requestedIds) {
            if (id == null) continue;
            if (!seen.add(id) || !ownedIds.contains(id)) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Operation ID does not belong to this bakery or is duplicated");
            }
        }
    }
```

```java
private BakeryOperationsDto toOperations(UUID bakeryId)
{
        List<BakeryOperationsDto.Address> addresses = addressRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakeryId)
                .stream().sorted(Comparator.comparing(BakeryAddress::getId))
                .map(address -> new BakeryOperationsDto.Address(address.getId(), address.getAddressLine(),
                        address.getWard(), address.getDistrict(), address.getCity(), address.getLatitude(),
                        address.getLongitude(), address.isPrimary())).toList();
        List<BakeryOperationsDto.ServiceArea> areas = serviceAreaRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakeryId)
                .stream().sorted(Comparator.comparing(ServiceArea::getId))
                .map(area -> new BakeryOperationsDto.ServiceArea(area.getId(), area.getCity(), area.getDistrict(),
                        area.getDeliveryFee(), area.getMinimumOrder(), area.isActive())).toList();
        List<BakeryOperationsDto.BusinessHour> hours = businessHourRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakeryId)
                .stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(BusinessHour::getDayOfWeek))
                .map(hour -> new BakeryOperationsDto.BusinessHour(hour.getDayOfWeek(), hour.getOpensAt(),
                        hour.getClosesAt(), hour.isClosed())).toList();
        return new BakeryOperationsDto(addresses, areas, hours);
```

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResult<PublicBakeryResponse> list(String query, String city, String district,
            int page, int size, String sort)
{
        if (page < 1 || size < 1 || size > 100) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "page must be >= 1 and size must be 1..100");
        }
        Sort ordering = AllowedSort.parse(sort, java.util.Set.of("name", "createdAt", "id"));
        long offset = (long) (page - 1) * size;
        long count = 0;
        List<PublicBakeryResponse> result = new ArrayList<>();
        int chunk = 0;
        Page<Bakery> candidates;
        do {
            candidates = bakeryRepository.search(BakeryStatus.ACTIVE,
                    query == null ? "" : query.trim(),
                    PageRequest.of(chunk++, 100, ordering));
            for (Bakery bakery : candidates.getContent()) {
                List<BakeryAddress> addresses = addressRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(bakery.getId());
                if (!matchesAddress(addresses, city, district)
                        || !entitlementClient.hasActiveSubscription(bakery.getId())) continue;
                if (count >= offset && result.size() < size) result.add(toResponse(bakery));
                count++;
            }
        } while (candidates.hasNext());
        return new PageResult<>(new PageResult.Meta(page, size,
                (int) ((count + size - 1) / size), count), result);
    }
```

```java
private boolean matchesAddress(List<BakeryAddress> addresses, String city, String district)
{
        if ((city == null || city.isBlank()) && (district == null || district.isBlank())) return true;
        return addresses.stream().anyMatch(address ->
                (city == null || city.isBlank() || address.getCity().equalsIgnoreCase(city.trim()))
                        && (district == null || district.isBlank()
                        || address.getDistrict().equalsIgnoreCase(district.trim())));
```

```java
public Bakery bakery(UUID id)
{
        var row =
                repository.one(
                        "select id,name,status from bakeries where id=:id", Map.of("id", id));
        var areas =
                repository
                        .list(
                                "select city,district,delivery_fee,minimum_order from service_areas"
                                        + " where bakery_id=:id and active=true",
                                Map.of("id", id))
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                a ->
                                        new Area(
                                                (String) a.get("city"),
                                                (String) a.get("district"),
                                                (BigDecimal) a.get("delivery_fee"),
                                                (BigDecimal) a.get("minimum_order")))
                        .toList();
        return new Bakery(id, (String) row.get("name"), (String) row.get("status"), areas);
    }
```

## bakery-service · CatalogServiceImpl.authorization

Nguồn: [CatalogServiceImpl.java:46](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/catalog/CatalogServiceImpl.java#L46). Kiểu trả về `Membership`.

```java
public Membership authorization(UUID bakeryId, UUID userId, String requiredRole)
{
        bakery(bakeryId);
        var membership =
                memberships(userId).stream()
                        .filter(m -> m.bakeryId().equals(bakeryId))
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElse(new Membership(bakeryId, userId, false, null, false));
        if (requiredRole == null) return membership;
        if (!"OWNER".equals(requiredRole))
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid membership role");
        boolean allowed =
                membership.active()
                        && "OWNER".equals(membership.memberRole());
        return new Membership(
                bakeryId, userId, membership.active(), membership.memberRole(), allowed);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`, `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`

## bakery-service · CatalogServiceImpl.quote

Nguồn: [CatalogServiceImpl.java:81](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/catalog/CatalogServiceImpl.java#L81). Kiểu trả về `Quote`.

```java
public Quote quote(QuoteRequest request, boolean productRequired)
{
        Bakery bakery = bakery(request.bakeryId());
        if (!"ACTIVE".equals(bakery.status())) throw BusinessException.conflict();
        if (!entitlementClient.hasActiveSubscription(request.bakeryId()))
            throw new BusinessException(409, "Bakery subscription is inactive");
        if (bakery.serviceAreas().stream()
                .noneMatch(
                        a ->
                                a.city().equalsIgnoreCase(request.deliveryCity())
                                        && a.district()
                                                .equalsIgnoreCase(request.deliveryDistrict())))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Outside service area");
        Map<String, Object> product = null;
        if (productRequired && request.productId() == null)
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Product required");
        if (request.productId() != null) {
            product =
                    repository.one(
                            "select * from products where id=:id and bakery_id=:bakeryId",
                            Map.of("id", request.productId(), "bakeryId", request.bakeryId()));
            if (!"PUBLISHED".equals(product.get("status"))) throw BusinessException.conflict();
        }
        var options = options(request);
        List<ItemSnapshot> items = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<UUID> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (AddOn selected : request.addOns() == null ? List.<AddOn>of() : request.addOns()) {
            if (!seen.add(selected.addOnId())) throw BusinessException.invalid("Duplicate add-on");
            var item =
                    repository.one(
                            "select * from add_ons where id=:id and bakery_id=:bakeryId and"
                                    + " active=true",
                            Map.of("id", selected.addOnId(), "bakeryId", request.bakeryId()));
            BigDecimal price = (BigDecimal) item.get("price");
            items.add(
                    new ItemSnapshot(
                            selected.addOnId(),
                            (String) item.get("name"),
                            (String) item.get("description"),
                            selected.quantity(),
                            price,
                            price.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(selected.quantity()))));
        }
        return new Quote(
                request.productId(),
                product == null ? null : (String) product.get("name"),
                product != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(product.get("customizable")),
                product == null ? 0 : (Integer) product.get("minimum_notice_hours"),
                options,
                items,
                items.stream()
                        .map(ItemSnapshot::lineTotal)
                        .reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`, `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`

## bakery-service · CatalogServiceImpl.options

Nguồn: [CatalogServiceImpl.java:135](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/catalog/CatalogServiceImpl.java#L135). Kiểu trả về `List<OptionSnapshot>`.

```java
private List<OptionSnapshot> options(QuoteRequest request)
{
        var selected =
                request.optionSelections() == null ? List.<Option>of() : request.optionSelections();
        if (request.productId() == null && !selected.isEmpty())
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Options require a product");
        List<OptionSnapshot> snapshots = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<UUID> seen = new HashSet<>();
        Map<UUID, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();
        for (Option option : selected) {
            if (!seen.add(option.optionValueId()))
                throw BusinessException.invalid("Duplicate option");
            var value =
                    repository.one(
                            "select g.name as group_name,v.name as value_name from"
                                + " product_option_groups g join product_option_values v on"
                                + " v.option_group_id=g.id where g.id=:groupId and v.id=:valueId"
                                + " and g.product_id=:productId and v.active=true",
                            Map.of(
                                    "groupId",
                                    option.optionGroupId(),
                                    "valueId",
                                    option.optionValueId(),
                                    "productId",
                                    request.productId()));
            counts.merge(option.optionGroupId(), 1, Integer::sum);
            snapshots.add(
                    new OptionSnapshot(
                            option.optionGroupId(),
                            option.optionValueId(),
                            (String) value.get("group_name"),
                            (String) value.get("value_name"),
                            option.quantity()));
        }
        if (request.productId() != null)
            for (var group :
                    repository.list(
                            "select * from product_option_groups where product_id=:id",
                            Map.of("id", request.productId()))) {
                int count = counts.getOrDefault((UUID) group.get("id"), 0),
                        min = (Integer) group.get("minimum_selections"),
                        max = (Integer) group.get("maximum_selections");
                if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(group.get("required"))) min = Math.max(1, min);
                if (count < min
                        || count > max
                        || ("SINGLE".equals(group.get("selection_type")) && count > 1))
                    throw BusinessException.invalid("Invalid option selection count");
            }
        return snapshots;
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`, `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`

## bakery-service · CatalogQuoteService.quote

Nguồn: [CatalogQuoteService.java:54](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/catalog/service/CatalogQuoteService.java#L54). Kiểu trả về `CatalogQuoteResponse`.

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CatalogQuoteResponse quote(CatalogQuoteRequest request)
{
        if (request == null || request.bakeryId() == null || request.productId() == null
                || request.quantity() < 1 || request.quantity() > 100
                || request.deliveryCity() == null || request.deliveryCity().isBlank()
                || request.deliveryDistrict() == null || request.deliveryDistrict().isBlank()) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid quote request");
        }
        Product product = productRepository.findByIdAndBakery_Id(request.productId(), request.bakeryId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Product not found"));
        if (product.getStatus() != ProductStatus.PUBLISHED
                || product.getBakery().getStatus() != BakeryStatus.ACTIVE) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Product or bakery is not public");
        }
        if (!entitlementClient.hasActiveSubscription(request.bakeryId())) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Bakery subscription is inactive");
        }
        ServiceArea area = areaRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(request.bakeryId()).stream()
                .filter(candidate -> candidate.isActive()
                        && candidate.getCity().equalsIgnoreCase(request.deliveryCity().trim())
                        && candidate.getDistrict().equalsIgnoreCase(request.deliveryDistrict().trim()))
                .findFirst().orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                        "Delivery area is not served"));

        Map<UUID, CatalogQuoteRequest.OptionSelection> selections = new HashMap<>();
        for (var selection : request.optionSelections() == null ? List.<CatalogQuoteRequest.OptionSelection>of()
                : request.optionSelections()) {
            if (selection == null || selection.optionGroupId() == null || selection.optionValueIds() == null
                    || selections.putIfAbsent(selection.optionGroupId(), selection) != null) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Duplicate or invalid option group");
            }
        }
        Map<UUID, List<ProductOptionValue>> valuesByGroup = new HashMap<>();
        for (ProductOptionValue value : valueRepository.findAllByOptionGroup_Product_Id(product.getId())) {
            valuesByGroup.computeIfAbsent(value.getOptionGroup().getId(), ignored -> new ArrayList<>()).add(value);
        }
        BigDecimal cakeUnitPrice = product.getBasePrice();
        List<Map<String, Object>> optionSnapshots = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ProductOptionGroup group : groupRepository.findAllByProduct_IdOrderByDisplayOrderAsc(product.getId())) {
            CatalogQuoteRequest.OptionSelection selection = selections.remove(group.getId());
            List<UUID> selectedIds = selection == null ? List.of() : selection.optionValueIds();
            if (selectedIds.size() < group.getMinimumSelections()
                    || selectedIds.size() > group.getMaximumSelections()
                    || (group.isRequired() && selectedIds.isEmpty())) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Option selection count is invalid");
            }
            Set<UUID> unique = new HashSet<>(selectedIds);
            if (unique.size() != selectedIds.size()) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Duplicate option value");
            }
            List<Map<String, Object>> valueSnapshots = new ArrayList<>();
            for (UUID selectedId : selectedIds) {
                ProductOptionValue value = valuesByGroup.getOrDefault(group.getId(), List.of()).stream()
                        .filter(candidate -> candidate.getId().equals(selectedId) && candidate.isActive())
                        .findFirst().orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                                "Option value is unavailable"));
                cakeUnitPrice = cakeUnitPrice.add(value.getPriceAdjustment());
                valueSnapshots.add(Map.of("id", value.getId().toString(), "name", value.getName(),
                        "priceAdjustment", value.getPriceAdjustment()));
            }
            if (!valueSnapshots.isEmpty()) {
                optionSnapshots.add(Map.of("groupId", group.getId().toString(),
                        "groupName", group.getName(), "values", valueSnapshots));
            }
        }
        if (!selections.isEmpty() || cakeUnitPrice.signum() < 0) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Invalid product option selection");
        }

        List<CatalogQuoteResponse.QuotedItem> items = new ArrayList<>();
        BigDecimal cakeTotal = cakeUnitPrice.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(request.quantity()));
        items.add(new CatalogQuoteResponse.QuotedItem(product.getId(), "CAKE", product.getName(),
                product.getDescription(), request.quantity(), cakeUnitPrice, cakeTotal,
                Map.of("options", optionSnapshots)));
        BigDecimal subtotal = cakeTotal;
        Set<UUID> addOnIds = new HashSet<>();
        for (var selection : request.addOns() == null ? List.<CatalogQuoteRequest.AddOnSelection>of()
                : request.addOns()) {
            if (selection == null || selection.addOnId() == null || selection.quantity() < 1
                    || selection.quantity() > 100 || !addOnIds.add(selection.addOnId())) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Invalid add-on selection");
            }
            AddOn addOn = addOnRepository.findByIdAndBakery_Id(selection.addOnId(), request.bakeryId())
                    .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Add-on not found"));
            if (!addOn.isActive()) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Add-on is inactive");
            }
            BigDecimal lineTotal = addOn.getPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(selection.quantity()));
            subtotal = subtotal.add(lineTotal);
            items.add(new CatalogQuoteResponse.QuotedItem(addOn.getId(), "ADD_ON", addOn.getName(),
                    addOn.getDescription(), selection.quantity(), addOn.getPrice(), lineTotal, Map.of()));
        }
        if (subtotal.compareTo(area.getMinimumOrder()) < 0) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Order is below delivery minimum");
        }
        return new CatalogQuoteResponse(UUID.randomUUID(), request.bakeryId(),
                product.getBakery().getName(), product.getId(), product.getName(),
                product.getDescription(), request.quantity(), List.copyOf(items), subtotal,
                area.getDeliveryFee(), subtotal.add(area.getDeliveryFee()),
                product.getMinimumNoticeHours(), Instant.now().plusSeconds(300));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## bakery-service · ProductCategoryServiceImpl.create

Nguồn: [ProductCategoryServiceImpl.java:41](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/category/service/impl/ProductCategoryServiceImpl.java#L41). Kiểu trả về `ProductCategoryDto`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public ProductCategoryDto create(UUID bakeryId, ProductCategoryDto request)
{
        rejectId(request);
        Bakery bakery = findBakery(bakeryId);
        String name = required(request.name(), "name");
        String slug = required(request.slug(), "slug");
        if (categoryRepository.existsByBakery_IdAndSlug(bakeryId, slug)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Category slug already exists");
        }
        ProductCategory category = new ProductCategory(bakery, name, slug);
        category.update(null, null, request.displayOrder(), request.active());
        return ProductCategoryDto.fromEntity(categoryRepository.saveAndFlush(category));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## bakery-service · ProductCategoryServiceImpl.update

Nguồn: [ProductCategoryServiceImpl.java:56](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/category/service/impl/ProductCategoryServiceImpl.java#L56). Kiểu trả về `ProductCategoryDto`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public ProductCategoryDto update(UUID bakeryId, UUID categoryId, ProductCategoryDto request)
{
        rejectId(request);
        ProductCategory category = categoryRepository.findByIdAndBakery_Id(categoryId, bakeryId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Category not found"));
        String slug = request.slug() == null ? null : required(request.slug(), "slug");
        if (slug != null && categoryRepository.existsByBakery_IdAndSlugAndIdNot(bakeryId, slug, categoryId)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Category slug already exists");
        }
        category.update(request.name() == null ? null : required(request.name(), "name"),
                slug, request.displayOrder(), request.active());
        categoryRepository.flush();
        return ProductCategoryDto.fromEntity(category);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## bakery-service · ProductCategoryServiceImpl.delete

Nguồn: [ProductCategoryServiceImpl.java:72](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/category/service/impl/ProductCategoryServiceImpl.java#L72). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public void delete(UUID bakeryId, UUID categoryId)
{
        ProductCategory category = categoryRepository.findByIdAndBakery_Id(categoryId, bakeryId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Category not found"));
        productRepository.findAllByCategory_Id(categoryId)
                .forEach(product -> product.updateCategory(null));
        productRepository.flush();
        categoryRepository.delete(category);
        categoryRepository.flush();
    }
```

```java
@Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<BakeryMemberDto> list(UUID bakeryId)
{
        if (!bakeryRepository.existsById(bakeryId)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Bakery not found");
        }
        return memberRepository.findAllByBakery_IdOrderByJoinedAtAsc(bakeryId)
                .stream().map(BakeryMemberDto::fromEntity).toList();
    }
```

## bakery-service · ProductServiceImpl.list

Nguồn: [ProductServiceImpl.java:73](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/product/service/impl/ProductServiceImpl.java#L73). Kiểu trả về `PageResult<ProductDto>`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResult<ProductDto> list(UUID bakeryId, ProductStatus status, UUID categoryId,
                                       String query, int page, int size, String sort)
{
        findBakery(bakeryId);
        if (page < 1 || size < 1 || size > 100) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "page must be >= 1 and size must be 1..100");
        }
        return PageResult.fromPage(productRepository.findManagement(bakeryId, status, categoryId,
                query == null ? "" : query.trim(),
                PageRequest.of(page - 1, size, AllowedSort.parse(sort, Set.of("createdAt", "name", "basePrice", "id"))))
                .map(ProductDto::fromEntity));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## bakery-service · ProductServiceImpl.create

Nguồn: [ProductServiceImpl.java:87](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/product/service/impl/ProductServiceImpl.java#L87). Kiểu trả về `ProductDto`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public ProductDto create(UUID bakeryId, ProductDto request)
{
        rejectServerFields(request);
        Bakery bakery = findBakery(bakeryId);
        ProductCategory category = resolveCategory(bakeryId, request.categoryId());
        String name = required(request.name(), "name");
        String slug = required(request.slug(), "slug");
        BigDecimal price = requiredPrice(request.basePrice());
        validateNumbers(request.defaultServingSize(), request.minimumNoticeHours());
        if (productRepository.existsByBakery_IdAndSlug(bakeryId, slug)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Product slug already exists");
        }
        Product product = new Product(bakery, category, name, slug, price);
        product.updateDetails(null, null, request.description(), null, request.customizable(),
                request.defaultServingSize(), request.minimumNoticeHours());
        return ProductDto.fromEntity(productRepository.saveAndFlush(product));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

<a id="m354"></a>

## bakery-service · ProductServiceImpl.update

Nguồn: [ProductServiceImpl.java:106](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/product/service/impl/ProductServiceImpl.java#L106). Kiểu trả về `ProductDto`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public ProductDto update(UUID bakeryId, UUID productId, ProductDto request)
{
        rejectServerFields(request);
        Product product = productRepository.findByIdAndBakery_Id(productId, bakeryId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Product not found"));
        if (request.categoryId() != null) {
            product.updateCategory(resolveCategory(bakeryId, request.categoryId()));
        }
        String slug = request.slug() == null ? null : required(request.slug(), "slug");
        if (slug != null && productRepository.existsByBakery_IdAndSlugAndIdNot(bakeryId, slug, productId)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Product slug already exists");
        }
        validateNumbers(request.defaultServingSize(), request.minimumNoticeHours());
        product.updateDetails(request.name() == null ? null : required(request.name(), "name"), slug,
                request.description(), request.basePrice() == null ? null : requiredPrice(request.basePrice()),
                request.customizable(), request.defaultServingSize(), request.minimumNoticeHours());
        productRepository.flush();
        return ProductDto.fromEntity(product);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

Nguồn: [ProductServiceImpl.java:127](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/product/service/impl/ProductServiceImpl.java#L127). Kiểu trả về `ProductOptionsDto`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public ProductOptionsDto replaceOptions(UUID bakeryId, UUID productId, ProductOptionsDto request)
{
        productRepository.findByIdAndBakery_Id(productId, bakeryId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Product not found"));
        if (request == null || request.groups() == null) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "groups is required");
        }

        Map<UUID, ProductOptionGroup> existingGroups = new HashMap<>();
        groupRepository.findAllByProduct_IdOrderByDisplayOrderAsc(productId)
                .forEach(group -> existingGroups.put(group.getId(), group));
        Map<UUID, ProductOptionValue> existingValues = new HashMap<>();
        valueRepository.findAllByOptionGroup_Product_Id(productId)
                .forEach(value -> existingValues.put(value.getId(), value));
        Set<UUID> retainedGroupIds = new HashSet<>();
        Set<UUID> retainedValueIds = new HashSet<>();

        for (ProductOptionsDto.Group group : request.groups()) {
            validateGroup(group);
            if (group.id() != null && (!existingGroups.containsKey(group.id())
                    || !retainedGroupIds.add(group.id()))) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                        "Option group ID is duplicated or belongs to another product");
            }
            for (ProductOptionsDto.Value value : group.values()) {
                validateValue(value);
                if (value.id() != null && (!existingValues.containsKey(value.id())
                        || !retainedValueIds.add(value.id()))) {
                    throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                            "Option value ID is duplicated or belongs to another product");
                }
            }
        }

        Product product = productRepository.getReferenceById(productId);
        List<ProductOptionGroup> savedGroups = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ProductOptionsDto.Group input : request.groups()) {
            ProductOptionGroup group = input.id() == null
                    ? new ProductOptionGroup(product, input.name().trim(), input.selectionType())
                    : existingGroups.get(input.id());
            group.update(input.name().trim(), input.selectionType(), input.required(),
                    input.minimumSelections(), input.maximumSelections(), order(input.displayOrder()));
            savedGroups.add(groupRepository.saveAndFlush(group));
        }

        List<List<ProductOptionValue>> savedValues = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < request.groups().size(); i++) {
            List<ProductOptionValue> groupValues = new ArrayList<>();
            for (ProductOptionsDto.Value input : request.groups().get(i).values()) {
                ProductOptionValue value = input.id() == null
                        ? new ProductOptionValue(savedGroups.get(i), input.name().trim(),
                                input.priceAdjustment())
                        : existingValues.get(input.id());
                value.update(savedGroups.get(i), input.name().trim(), input.description(),
                        input.priceAdjustment(), input.active(), order(input.displayOrder()));
                groupValues.add(valueRepository.save(value));
            }
            savedValues.add(groupValues);
        }
        valueRepository.flush();
        existingValues.values().stream().filter(value -> !retainedValueIds.contains(value.getId()))
                .forEach(valueRepository::delete);
        valueRepository.flush();
        existingGroups.values().stream().filter(group -> !retainedGroupIds.contains(group.getId()))
                .forEach(groupRepository::delete);
        groupRepository.flush();

        List<ProductOptionsDto.Group> responseGroups = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < savedGroups.size(); i++) {
            responseGroups.add(ProductOptionsDto.Group.fromEntity(savedGroups.get(i), savedValues.get(i)));
        }
        return new ProductOptionsDto(responseGroups);
    }
```

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public List<ProductImageResponse> uploadImages(UUID bakeryId, UUID productId,
            List<MultipartFile> files, Integer primaryIndex, List<Integer> displayOrder)
{
        Product product = productRepository.findByIdAndBakery_Id(productId, bakeryId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Product not found"));
        if (files == null || files.isEmpty() || files.size() > 10
                || imageRepository.countByProduct_Id(productId) + files.size() > 10) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Product requires 1 to 10 images in total");
        }
        if (primaryIndex != null && (primaryIndex < 0 || primaryIndex >= files.size())) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "primaryIndex is outside the file list");
        }
        if (displayOrder != null && displayOrder.size() != files.size()) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "displayOrder must match the file list");
        }
        if (displayOrder != null && displayOrder.stream()
                .anyMatch(value -> value == null || value < 0)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "displayOrder must be non-negative");
        }
        boolean hasPrimary = imageRepository.existsByProduct_IdAndIsPrimaryTrue(productId);
        if (primaryIndex != null && hasPrimary) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Product already has a primary image");
        }
        int selectedPrimary = hasPrimary ? -1 : primaryIndex == null ? 0 : primaryIndex;
        List<ProductImageResponse> responses = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int index = 0; index < files.size(); index++) {
            BakeryImageStorage.StoredImage stored = imageStorage.upload(files.get(index),
                    "bakeries/" + bakeryId + "/products/" + productId);
            ProductImage image = new ProductImage(product, stored.objectKey(), stored.mediaType());
            image.configure(displayOrder == null ? index : displayOrder.get(index), index == selectedPrimary);
            String url = imageStorage.signedUrl(stored.objectKey());
            imageRepository.saveAndFlush(image);
            responses.add(new ProductImageResponse(image.getId(), url,
                    Instant.now().plus(imageStorage.urlExpiry()), stored.mediaType(),
                    image.getDisplayOrder(), image.isPrimary()));
        }
        return List.copyOf(responses);
    }
```

## bakery-service · ProductServiceImpl.publish

Nguồn: [ProductServiceImpl.java:254](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/product/service/impl/ProductServiceImpl.java#L254). Kiểu trả về `ProductDto`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public ProductDto publish(UUID bakeryId, UUID productId)
{
        Product product = findProduct(bakeryId, productId);
        if (product.getStatus() != ProductStatus.DRAFT && product.getStatus() != ProductStatus.HIDDEN) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Only draft or hidden products can be published");
        }
        if (product.getBakery().getStatus() != BakeryStatus.ACTIVE
                || product.getBasePrice() == null || product.getBasePrice().signum() < 0
                || !imageRepository.existsByProduct_IdAndIsPrimaryTrue(productId)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "Product requires an active bakery, valid price and primary image");
        }
        List<ProductOptionValue> optionValues = valueRepository.findAllByOptionGroup_Product_Id(productId);
        for (ProductOptionGroup group : groupRepository.findAllByProduct_IdOrderByDisplayOrderAsc(productId)) {
            long activeCount = optionValues.stream()
                    .filter(value -> value.getOptionGroup().getId().equals(group.getId()) && value.isActive()).count();
            if (group.isRequired() && activeCount < group.getMinimumSelections()) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Required product options are incomplete");
            }
        }
        if (!entitlementClient.hasActiveSubscription(bakeryId)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Bakery subscription is inactive");
        }
        product.publish();
        productRepository.flush();
        return ProductDto.fromEntity(product);
    }
```

```java
                || group.name().length() > 120 || group.selectionType() == null
                || group.required() == null || group.minimumSelections() == null

                || (group.required() && group.minimumSelections() < 1)
                || (group.selectionType() == SelectionType.SINGLE && group.maximumSelections() > 1)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Invalid option selection range");
        }
```

## bakery-service · PublicProductService.list

Nguồn: [PublicProductService.java:65](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/feature/product/service/PublicProductService.java#L65). Kiểu trả về `PageResult<PublicProductResponse>`.

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResult<PublicProductResponse> list(String query, UUID bakeryId, UUID categoryId,
            String city, Boolean customizable, BigDecimal minPrice, BigDecimal maxPrice,
            int page, int size, String sort)
{
        if (page < 1 || size < 1 || size > 100 || minPrice != null && minPrice.signum() < 0
                || maxPrice != null && maxPrice.signum() < 0
                || minPrice != null && maxPrice != null && minPrice.compareTo(maxPrice) > 0) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid product filters or pagination");
        }
        Sort ordering = AllowedSort.parse(sort, java.util.Set.of("createdAt", "name", "basePrice", "id"));
        long offset = (long) (page - 1) * size;
        long count = 0;
        List<PublicProductResponse> result = new ArrayList<>();
        Map<UUID, Boolean> entitlement = new HashMap<>();
        Map<UUID, Boolean> cityMatch = new HashMap<>();
        int chunk = 0;
        Page<Product> candidates;
        do {
            candidates = productRepository.findPublicCandidates(ProductStatus.PUBLISHED,
                    BakeryStatus.ACTIVE, bakeryId, categoryId, customizable, minPrice, maxPrice,
                    query == null ? "" : query.trim(),
                    PageRequest.of(chunk++, 100, ordering));
            for (Product product : candidates.getContent()) {
                UUID candidateBakeryId = product.getBakery().getId();
                boolean matchesCity = city == null || city.isBlank()
                        || cityMatch.computeIfAbsent(candidateBakeryId, id ->
                        addressRepository.findAllByBakery_Id(id).stream()
                                .map(BakeryAddress::getCity).anyMatch(value -> value.equalsIgnoreCase(city.trim())));
                if (!matchesCity || !entitlement.computeIfAbsent(candidateBakeryId,
                        entitlementClient::hasActiveSubscription)) continue;
                if (count >= offset && result.size() < size) result.add(toResponse(product, false));
                count++;
            }
        } while (candidates.hasNext());
        return new PageResult<>(new PageResult.Meta(page, size,
                (int) ((count + size - 1) / size), count), result);
    }
```

```java
                .stream().map(image -> new ProductImageResponse(image.getId(),

                        Instant.now().plus(imageStorage.urlExpiry()), image.getMediaType(),
                        image.getDisplayOrder(), image.isPrimary())).toList();
        ProductOptionsDto options = new ProductOptionsDto(List.of());
        List<PublicAddOnResponse> addOns = List.of();
        if (detail) {
            var values = valueRepository.findAllByOptionGroup_Product_Id(product.getId());
            options = new ProductOptionsDto(groupRepository.findAllByProduct_IdOrderByDisplayOrderAsc(product.getId())
                    .stream().map(group -> ProductOptionsDto.Group.fromEntity(group,
                            values.stream().filter(value -> value.getOptionGroup().getId().equals(group.getId())
                                    && value.isActive()).toList())).toList());
            addOns = addOnRepository.findAllByBakery_IdOrderByNameAsc(bakeryId).stream()
                    .filter(addOn -> addOn.isActive())
                    .map(addOn -> new PublicAddOnResponse(addOn.getId(), addOn.getName(),
                            addOn.getDescription(), addOn.getCategory(), addOn.getPrice(),
                            addOn.getImageObjectKey() == null ? null
                                    : imageStorage.signedUrl(addOn.getImageObjectKey())))
                    .toList();
        }
        return new PublicProductResponse(ProductDto.fromEntity(product), bakeryId,
                product.getBakery().getName(), product.getCategory() == null ? null
                : ProductCategoryDto.fromEntity(product.getCategory()), images, options, addOns);
    }
```

```java
public UserProfile getUser(UUID userId)
{
        try {
            String bearer = serviceToken.isBlank()
                    ? tokenClient.serviceToken("identity-service", "identity:user:read") : serviceToken;
            UserProfile user = client.get().uri("/internal/v1/users/{userId}", userId)
                    .headers(headers -> {
                        headers.setBearerAuth(bearer);
                        headers.set("X-Correlation-Id", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
                    })
                    .retrieve().body(UserProfile.class);
            if (user == null || !userId.equals(user.id())
                    || user.displayName() == null || user.displayName().isBlank()
                    || user.displayName().length() > 120) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Invalid Identity response");
            }
            if (!"ACTIVE".equals(user.status())) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "User is not active");
            }
            return user;
        } catch (com.se193262.platform.exception.AppException exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Identity service credential is unavailable");
        } catch (RestClientResponseException exception) {
            if (exception.getStatusCode().value() == 404) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "User not found");
            }
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Identity service is unavailable");
        } catch (RestClientException exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Identity service is unavailable");
        }
    }
```

## bakery-service · BakeryImageStorage.upload

Nguồn: [BakeryImageStorage.java:52](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/infrastructure/storage/BakeryImageStorage.java#L52). Kiểu trả về `StoredImage`.

```java
public StoredImage upload(MultipartFile file, String prefix)
{
        if (file == null || file.isEmpty() || file.getSize() > MAX_BYTES) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Image must be between 1 byte and 5 MB");
        }
        try {
            byte[] bytes = file.getBytes();
            if (bytes.length == 0 || bytes.length > MAX_BYTES) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Image must be between 1 byte and 5 MB");
            }
            String mediaType = detect(bytes);
            String declared = file.getContentType() == null ? ""
                    : file.getContentType().split(";", 2)[0].trim();
            if (mediaType == null || !mediaType.equalsIgnoreCase(declared)) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Unsupported image or content type mismatch");
            }
            String key = prefix + "/" + UUID.randomUUID();
            MinioClient client = client();
            if (!client.bucketExists(BucketExistsArgs.builder().bucket(bucket).build())) {
                client.makeBucket(MakeBucketArgs.builder().bucket(bucket).build());
            }
            client.putObject(PutObjectArgs.builder().bucket(bucket).object(key)
                    .stream(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes), bytes.length, -1)
                    .contentType(mediaType).build());
            onRollbackDelete(key);
            return new StoredImage(key, mediaType);
        } catch (AppException exception) {
            throw exception;
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Image could not be read");
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Image storage is unavailable");
        }
    }
```

```java
public void afterCommitDelete(String key)
{
        if (key == null) return;
        if (TransactionSynchronizationManager.isSynchronizationActive()) {
            TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new TransactionSynchronization() {
                @Override public void afterCommit() { deleteQuietly(key); }
            });
        } else {
            deleteQuietly(key);
        }
    }
```

```java
private void onRollbackDelete(String key)
{
        if (TransactionSynchronizationManager.isSynchronizationActive()) {
            TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new TransactionSynchronization() {
                @Override public void afterCompletion(int status) {
                    if (status != STATUS_COMMITTED) deleteQuietly(key);
                }
            });
        }
    }
```

## bakery-service · BakeryImageStorage.detect

Nguồn: [BakeryImageStorage.java:138](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/infrastructure/storage/BakeryImageStorage.java#L138). Kiểu trả về `String`.

```java
private String detect(byte[] bytes)
{
        if (bytes.length >= 3 && (bytes[0] & 0xff) == 0xff && (bytes[1] & 0xff) == 0xd8
                && (bytes[2] & 0xff) == 0xff) return "image/jpeg";
        if (bytes.length >= 8 && (bytes[0] & 0xff) == 0x89 && bytes[1] == 'P'
                && bytes[2] == 'N' && bytes[3] == 'G' && bytes[4] == 13
                && bytes[5] == 10 && bytes[6] == 26 && bytes[7] == 10) return "image/png";
        if (bytes.length >= 12 && bytes[0] == 'R' && bytes[1] == 'I' && bytes[2] == 'F'
                && bytes[3] == 'F' && bytes[8] == 'W' && bytes[9] == 'E'
                && bytes[10] == 'B' && bytes[11] == 'P') return "image/webp";
        return null;
    }
```

## bakery-service · JwtDecoderConfig.jwtDecoder

Nguồn: [JwtDecoderConfig.java:21](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/security/JwtDecoderConfig.java#L21). Kiểu trả về `JwtDecoder`.

```java
@Bean
    @ConditionalOnMissingBean(JwtDecoder.class)
    JwtDecoder jwtDecoder(
            @Value("${spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.jwk-set-uri}") String jwksUri,
            @Value("${spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri}") String issuer,
            @Value("${security.jwt.user-audience:bakery-platform-api}") String userAudience,
            @Value("${security.jwt.service-audience:bakery-service}") String serviceAudience)
{
        NimbusJwtDecoder decoder = NimbusJwtDecoder.withJwkSetUri(jwksUri)
                .jwsAlgorithm(SignatureAlgorithm.RS256).build();
        OAuth2TokenValidator<Jwt> audience = jwt -> {
            String type = jwt.getClaimAsString("token_type");
            String expected = "user".equals(type) ? userAudience
                    : "service".equals(type) ? serviceAudience : null;
            return expected != null && jwt.getAudience().contains(expected)
                    ? OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.success()
                    : OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.failure(new OAuth2Error("invalid_token",
                            "Invalid token type or audience", null));
        };
        decoder.setJwtValidator(new DelegatingOAuth2TokenValidator<>(
                new JwtTimestampValidator(), new JwtIssuerValidator(issuer), audience,
                new JwtClaimValidator<String>("sub", subject -> subject != null && !subject.isBlank())));
        return decoder;
    }
```

```java
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http,
            JwtAuthenticationConverter jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler) throws Exception
{
        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())

                .authorizeHttpRequests(authorize -> authorize
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/api/v1/bakeries/onboarding")

                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/bakeries/onboarding",

                        .access(userRole("CUSTOMER"))

                        .permitAll()

                                "/api/v1/products", "/api/v1/products/{productId}").permitAll()

                        .access(serviceScope("bakery:profile:read"))

                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products")

                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PUT,

                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products/{productId}/options")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())

                        .access(bakeryOwner())

                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .anyRequest().denyAll())
                .oauth2ResourceServer(resourceServer -> resourceServer
                        .jwt(jwt -> jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(jwtAuthenticationConverter))
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler))

                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
```

```java
@Bean
    JwtAuthenticationConverter jwtAuthenticationConverter()
{
        JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter roles = new JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter();
        roles.setAuthoritiesClaimName("roles");
        roles.setAuthorityPrefix("ROLE_");
        JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter scopes = new JwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter();
        scopes.setAuthoritiesClaimName("scope");
        JwtAuthenticationConverter converter = new JwtAuthenticationConverter();
        converter.setJwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter(new DelegatingJwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter(roles, scopes));
        return converter;
    }
```

## bakery-service · SecurityConfig.serviceScope

Nguồn: [SecurityConfig.java:154](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/security/SecurityConfig.java#L154). Kiểu trả về `AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext>`.

```java
private AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext> serviceScope(String scope)
{
        return (authentication, context) -> {
            Authentication resolved = authentication.get();
            if (!(resolved instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken token) || !resolved.isAuthenticated()) {
                return new AuthorizationDecision(false);
            }
            String correlationId = context.getRequest().getHeader("X-Correlation-Id");
            String scopes = token.getToken().getClaimAsString("scope");
            boolean allowed = "service".equals(token.getToken().getClaimAsString("token_type"))
                    && token.getToken().getAudience().contains(serviceAudience)
                    && correlationId != null && !correlationId.isBlank()
                    && scopes != null && Arrays.asList(scopes.split(" ")).contains(scope);
            return new AuthorizationDecision(allowed);
        };
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`

## bakery-service · SecurityConfig.bakeryOwner

Nguồn: [SecurityConfig.java:170](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/security/SecurityConfig.java#L170). Kiểu trả về `AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext>`.

```java
private AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext> bakeryOwner()
{
        return (authentication, context) -> {
            Authentication resolved = authentication.get();
            if (!isUser(resolved)
                    || !hasRole(resolved, "BAKERY_OWNER")) {
                return new AuthorizationDecision(false);
            }
            try {
                String bakeryIdValue = context.getVariables().get("bakeryId");
                if (bakeryIdValue == null) {
                    return new AuthorizationDecision(false);
                }
                UUID bakeryId = UUID.fromString(bakeryIdValue);
                UUID userId = UUID.fromString(((JwtAuthenticationToken) resolved).getToken().getSubject());
                boolean allowed = memberRepository.findByBakery_IdAndUserId(bakeryId, userId)
                        .filter(member -> member.getStatus() == BakeryMemberStatus.ACTIVE)
                        .map(member -> member.getMemberRole() == BakeryMemberRole.OWNER)
                        .orElse(false);
                return new AuthorizationDecision(allowed);
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
                return new AuthorizationDecision(false);
            }
        };
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`

```java
private boolean isUser(Authentication authentication)
{
        if (!(authentication instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken jwtAuthentication)
                || !authentication.isAuthenticated()
                || !"user".equals(jwtAuthentication.getToken().getClaimAsString("token_type"))
                || jwtAuthentication.getToken().getSubject() == null) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            UUID.fromString(jwtAuthentication.getToken().getSubject());
            return true;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            return false;
        }
    }
```

## bakery-service · AllowedSort.parse

Nguồn: [AllowedSort.java:12](../../../backend/bakery-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/bakeryservice/shared/AllowedSort.java#L12). Kiểu trả về `Sort`.

```java
public static Sort parse(String value, Set<String> fields)
{
        String[] parts = value == null ? new String[0] : value.split(",", -1);
        if (parts.length != 2 || !fields.contains(parts[0])
                || !(parts[1].equals("asc") || parts[1].equals("desc"))) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid sort field or direction");
        }
        Sort sort = Sort.by(parts[1].equals("asc") ? Sort.Direction.ASC : Sort.Direction.DESC, parts[0]);
        return parts[0].equals("id") ? sort : sort.and(Sort.by("id"));
    }
```

```java
public GeneratedDesignResponse moderate(UUID id, String status)
{
        Actor actor = Actor.current();
        if (!actor.admin()) throw BusinessException.forbidden();
        if (!Set.of("APPROVED", "REJECTED").contains(status)) throw BusinessException.invalid("Invalid moderation status");
        transaction.executeWithoutResult(ignored -> {
            repository.design(id);
            repository.moderate(id, status, actor.id());
        });
        return get(id);
    }
```

```java
public Map<String, Object> validate(UUID designId, UUID customerId, UUID cakeRequestId)
{
        var row =
                jdbc
                        .sql(
                                "select"
                                    + " d.id,d.moderation_status,j.customer_id,j.cake_request_id,j.status"
                                    + " from generated_designs d join generation_jobs j on"
                                    + " j.id=d.generation_job_id where d.id=:id")
                        .param("id", designId)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows()
                        .stream()
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow(BusinessException::missing);
        return Map.of(
                "id",
                designId,
                "exists",
                true,
                "ownerMatches",
                customerId.equals(row.get("customer_id")),
                "requestMatches",
                cakeRequestId.equals(row.get("cake_request_id")),
                "moderationStatus",
                row.get("moderation_status"),
                "jobStatus",
                row.get("status"));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`, `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`

## cake-ai-service · GenerationInputs.validateFiles

Nguồn: [GenerationInputs.java:36](../../../backend/cake-ai-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/cakeaiservice/feature/generation/GenerationInputs.java#L36). Kiểu trả về `List<Image>`.

```java
public List<Image> validateFiles(List<MultipartFile> files)
{
        if (files == null) return List.of();
        if (files.size() > 5) throw BusinessException.invalid("At most five source images are allowed");
        List<Image> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (MultipartFile file : files) {
            if (file.getSize() > 10 * 1024 * 1024) throw BusinessException.invalid("Image exceeds 10 MB");
            try { result.add(validator.validate(file.getBytes())); }
            catch (java.io.IOException error) { throw BusinessException.invalid("Cannot read source image"); }
        }
        return result;
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`
