## identity-service · JwtConfig.jwtDecoder

Nguồn: [JwtConfig.java:74](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/config/JwtConfig.java#L74). Kiểu trả về `JwtDecoder`.

```java
@Bean
    JwtDecoder jwtDecoder(RSAKey rsaKey, JwtProperties properties) throws Exception
{
        NimbusJwtDecoder decoder = NimbusJwtDecoder.withPublicKey(rsaKey.toRSAPublicKey())
                .signatureAlgorithm(SignatureAlgorithm.RS256)
                .build();

        OAuth2TokenValidator<Jwt> audienceValidator = token -> {
            String tokenType = token.getClaimAsString("token_type");
            String requiredAudience = "service".equals(tokenType)
                    ? properties.serviceAudience()
                    : "user".equals(tokenType) ? properties.userAudience() : null;
            if (requiredAudience != null && token.getAudience().contains(requiredAudience)) {
                return OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.success();
            }
            return OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.failure(INVALID_AUDIENCE);
        };

        decoder.setJwtValidator(new DelegatingOAuth2TokenValidator<>(
                new JwtTimestampValidator(),
                new JwtIssuerValidator(requireText(properties.issuer(), "security.jwt.issuer")),
                audienceValidator,
                new JwtClaimValidator<String>("sub", subject -> subject != null && !subject.isBlank())
        ));
        return decoder;
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties({JwtProperties.class, AuthProperties.class, CorsProperties.class})`

## identity-service · JwtConfig.readPrivateKey

Nguồn: [JwtConfig.java:105](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/config/JwtConfig.java#L105). Kiểu trả về `RSAPrivateKey`.

```java
private RSAPrivateKey readPrivateKey(JwtProperties properties)
{
        String pem = readPem(properties.privateKeyPath(), "security.jwt.private-key-path");
        byte[] encoded = decodePem(pem, "PRIVATE KEY");
        try {
            return (RSAPrivateKey) KeyFactory.getInstance("RSA")
                    .generatePrivate(new PKCS8EncodedKeySpec(encoded));
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot parse JWT PKCS#8 private key", exception);
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties({JwtProperties.class, AuthProperties.class, CorsProperties.class})`

```java
private String readPem(java.nio.file.Path path, String propertyName)
{
        if (path == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(propertyName + " must be configured");
        }
        try {
            return Files.readString(path, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot read " + propertyName + " from " + path, exception);
        }
    }
```

## identity-service · JwtConfig.decodePem

Nguồn: [JwtConfig.java:138](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/config/JwtConfig.java#L138). Kiểu trả về `byte[]`.

```java
private byte[] decodePem(String pem, String type)
{
        String normalized = pem
                .replace("-----BEGIN " + type + "-----", "")
                .replace("-----END " + type + "-----", "")
                .replaceAll("\\s", "");
        try {
            return Base64.getDecoder().decode(normalized);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid PEM content for " + type, exception);
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties({JwtProperties.class, AuthProperties.class, CorsProperties.class})`

## identity-service · SecurityConfig.securityFilterChain

Nguồn: [SecurityConfig.java:45](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/config/SecurityConfig.java#L45). Kiểu trả về `SecurityFilterChain`.

```java
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(
            HttpSecurity http,
            Converter<Jwt, ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken> jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler,
            CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource)
            throws Exception
{
        http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .cors(cors -> cors.configurationSource(corsConfigurationSource))
                .sessionManagement(
                        session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(
                        authorize ->
                                authorize
                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.POST, "/internal/v1/auth/service-token")
                                        .permitAll()
                                        .requestMatchers("/actuator/health", "/actuator/health/**")
                                        .permitAll()
                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.GET,
                                                "/.well-known/jwks.json",
                                                "/v3/api-docs/**",
                                                "/v3/api-docs.yaml",
                                                "/swagger-ui/**",
                                                "/swagger-ui.html")
                                        .permitAll()
                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.POST,
                                                "/api/v1/auth/register",
                                                "/api/v1/auth/login",
                                                "/api/v1/auth/refresh")
                                        .permitAll()
                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.GET, "/internal/v1/users/*/addresses/*")
                                        .access(serviceScope("identity:address:read"))
                                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/internal/v1/users/*")
                                        .access(serviceScope("identity:user:read"))
                                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PUT, "/internal/v1/users/*/bakery-owner")
                                        .access(serviceScope("identity:bakery-owner:grant"))
                                        .requestMatchers("/internal/v1/**")
                                        .denyAll()
                                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/admin/**")
                                        .access(userRole("ROLE_ADMIN"))
                                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/**")
                                        .access(tokenType("user"))
                                        .anyRequest()
                                        .denyAll())
                .oauth2ResourceServer(
                        resourceServer ->
                                resourceServer
                                        .jwt(
                                                jwt ->
                                                        jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(
                                                                jwtAuthenticationConverter))
                                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler))
                .exceptionHandling(
                        exceptions ->
                                exceptions
                                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler));
        return http.build();
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`

```java
@Bean
    CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource(CorsProperties properties)
{
        CorsConfiguration configuration = new CorsConfiguration();
        configuration.setAllowedOrigins(properties.allowedOrigins());
        configuration.setAllowedMethods(
                List.of("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"));
        configuration.setAllowedHeaders(
                List.of(
                        "Authorization",
                        "Content-Type",
                        "Cache-Control",
                        "Idempotency-Key",
                        "X-Correlation-Id"));
        configuration.setAllowCredentials(true);
        UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", configuration);
        return source;
    }
```

## identity-service · SecurityConfig.hasAuthority

```java
private boolean hasAuthority(
            Supplier<? extends Authentication> authentication, String authority)
{
        Authentication resolved = authentication.get();
        return resolved != null
                && resolved.getAuthorities().stream()
                        .anyMatch(
                                grantedAuthority ->
                                        authority.equals(grantedAuthority.getAuthority()));
    }
```

```java
@ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Map<String, String>>> handleValidation(
            MethodArgumentNotValidException exception)
{
        Map<String, String> errors = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        exception
                .getBindingResult()
                .getFieldErrors()
                .forEach(error -> errors.putIfAbsent(error.getField(), error.getDefaultMessage()));
        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                .body(ApiResponse.of(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(), "Validation failed", errors));
    }
```

```java
private ResponseCookie refreshCookie(String value, Duration maxAge)

                .httpOnly(true)
                .secure(authProperties.refreshCookieSecure())
                .sameSite(authProperties.refreshCookieSameSite())
                .path(authProperties.refreshCookiePath())
                .maxAge(maxAge)
                .build();
    }
```

## identity-service · AuthenticationController.readRefreshToken

```java
private String readRefreshToken(HttpServletRequest request)
{
        Cookie[] cookies = request.getCookies();
        if (cookies == null) {
            return null;
        }
        for (Cookie cookie : cookies) {
            if (authProperties.refreshCookieName().equals(cookie.getName())) {
                return cookie.getValue();
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
```

## identity-service · AuthenticationServiceImpl.register

Nguồn: [AuthenticationServiceImpl.java:58](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/authentication/AuthenticationServiceImpl.java#L58). Kiểu trả về `UserProfileResponse`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public UserProfileResponse register(RegisterRequest request)
{
        String email = normalizeEmail(request.email());
        if (userRepository.existsByEmail(email)) {
            throw new DuplicateEmailException();
        }
        Role customerRole = roleRepository.findByCode(PlatformRole.CUSTOMER.name())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("CUSTOMER role has not been seeded"));
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        User user = new User(
                email,
                passwordEncoder.encode(request.password()),
                request.displayName().trim(),
                normalizeNullable(request.phoneNumber()),
                UserStatus.ACTIVE,
                now
        );
        user.addRole(customerRole);
        user.setCustomerProfile(new CustomerProfile(user, "vi", now));
        User savedUser = userRepository.save(user);
        return UserProfileResponse.fromEntity(savedUser);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## identity-service · AuthenticationServiceImpl.login

Nguồn: [AuthenticationServiceImpl.java:82](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/authentication/AuthenticationServiceImpl.java#L82). Kiểu trả về `AuthenticationResult`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public AuthenticationResult login(LoginRequest request)
{
        String email = normalizeEmail(request.email());
        Authentication authentication;
        try {
            authentication = authenticationManager.authenticate(
                    UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.unauthenticated(email, request.password()));
        } catch (AccountStatusException exception) {
            throw new AccountUnavailableException();
        } catch (AuthenticationException exception) {
            throw new AuthenticationFailedException();
        }
        UserPrincipal principal = (UserPrincipal) authentication.getPrincipal();
        User user = userRepository.findById(principal.id())
                .orElseThrow(AuthenticationFailedException::new);
        return tokenSessionService.createSession(user);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## identity-service · JwtTokenService.issueUserToken

Nguồn: [JwtTokenService.java:34](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/authentication/JwtTokenService.java#L34). Kiểu trả về `AccessToken`.

```java
public AccessToken issueUserToken(User user)
{
        Instant issuedAt = clock.instant();
        Duration timeToLive = properties.accessTokenTtl();
        Instant expiresAt = issuedAt.plus(timeToLive);
        List<String> roles = user.getRoles().stream()
                .map(role -> role.getCode())
                .sorted()
                .toList();

        JwsHeader header = JwsHeader.with(SignatureAlgorithm.RS256)
                .keyId(rsaKey.getKeyID())
                .build();
        JwtClaimsSet claims = JwtClaimsSet.builder()
                .issuer(properties.issuer())
                .subject(user.getId().toString())
                .audience(List.of(properties.userAudience()))
                .issuedAt(issuedAt)
                .expiresAt(expiresAt)
                .id(UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                .claim("token_type", "user")
                .claim("email", user.getEmail())
                .claim("roles", roles)
                .build();

        String value = jwtEncoder.encode(JwtEncoderParameters.from(header, claims)).getTokenValue();
        return new AccessToken(value, timeToLive.toSeconds());
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

```java
public String hash(String rawToken)
{
        try {
            byte[] digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                    .digest(rawToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest);
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is unavailable", exception);
        }
    }
```

## identity-service · ServiceTokenService.issue

Nguồn: [ServiceTokenService.java:37](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/authentication/ServiceTokenService.java#L37). Kiểu trả về `ServiceTokenResponse`.

```java
public ServiceTokenResponse issue(ServiceTokenRequest request)
{
        var configured =
                clients.clients() == null ? null : clients.clients().get(request.clientId());
        if (configured == null
                || configured.secretHash() == null
                || !encoder.matches(request.clientSecret(), configured.secretHash()))
            throw new ServiceAuthenticationFailedException();
        String granted =
                configured.grants() == null ? null : configured.grants().get(request.audience());
        Set<String> requested = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(request.scope().split(" +")));
        if (granted == null
                || requested.isEmpty()
                || !Set.of(granted.split(" +")).containsAll(requested))
            throw new ServiceAuthenticationFailedException();
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        var claims =
                JwtClaimsSet.builder()
                        .issuer(jwt.issuer())
                        .subject(request.clientId())
                        .audience(List.of(request.audience()))
                        .issuedAt(now)
                        .expiresAt(now.plusSeconds(300))
                        .id(UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                        .claim("token_type", "service")
                        .claim("scope", String.join(" ", new TreeSet<>(requested)))
                        .build();
        var header = JwsHeader.with(SignatureAlgorithm.RS256).keyId(jwt.keyId()).build();
        return new ServiceTokenResponse(
                jwtEncoder.encode(JwtEncoderParameters.from(header, claims)).getTokenValue(), 300);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties(ServiceClientProperties.class)`

Nguồn: [TokenSessionService.java:47](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/authentication/TokenSessionService.java#L47). Kiểu trả về `AuthenticationResult`.

```java
@Transactional
    public AuthenticationResult createSession(User user)
{
        AccessToken accessToken = jwtTokenService.issueUserToken(user);
        String rawRefreshToken = refreshTokenGenerator.generate();
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        RefreshToken refreshToken = new RefreshToken(
                user,
                refreshTokenHasher.hash(rawRefreshToken),
                now.plus(authProperties.refreshTokenTtl()),
                now
        );
        refreshTokenRepository.save(refreshToken);
        TokenResponse response = new TokenResponse(accessToken.value(), "Bearer", accessToken.expiresInSeconds());
        return new AuthenticationResult(response, rawRefreshToken);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## identity-service · TokenSessionService.refresh

Nguồn: [TokenSessionService.java:63](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/authentication/TokenSessionService.java#L63). Kiểu trả về `AuthenticationResult`.

```java
@Transactional(noRollbackFor = {InvalidRefreshTokenException.class, AccountUnavailableException.class})
    public AuthenticationResult refresh(String rawRefreshToken)
{
        if (rawRefreshToken == null || rawRefreshToken.isBlank()) {
            throw new InvalidRefreshTokenException();
        }
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        RefreshToken storedToken = refreshTokenRepository
                .findByTokenHashForUpdate(refreshTokenHasher.hash(rawRefreshToken))
                .orElseThrow(InvalidRefreshTokenException::new);
        UUID userId = storedToken.getUser().getId();

        rejectRevokedOrExpired(storedToken, userId, now);
        User user = userRepository.findById(userId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("User"));
        if (user.getStatus() != UserStatus.ACTIVE) {
            refreshTokenRepository.revokeAllActiveByUserId(userId, now);
            throw new AccountUnavailableException();
        }
        storedToken.revoke(now);
        return createSession(user);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## identity-service · TokenSessionService.logout

Nguồn: [TokenSessionService.java:85](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/authentication/TokenSessionService.java#L85). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
@Transactional
    public void logout(String rawRefreshToken)
{
        if (rawRefreshToken == null || rawRefreshToken.isBlank()) {
            return;
        }
        refreshTokenRepository.findByTokenHashForUpdate(refreshTokenHasher.hash(rawRefreshToken))
                .ifPresent(token -> token.revoke(clock.instant()));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## identity-service · TokenSessionService.rejectRevokedOrExpired

Nguồn: [TokenSessionService.java:94](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/authentication/TokenSessionService.java#L94). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
private void rejectRevokedOrExpired(RefreshToken storedToken, UUID userId, Instant now)
{
        if (storedToken.getRevokedAt() != null) {
            refreshTokenRepository.revokeAllActiveByUserId(userId, now);
            throw new InvalidRefreshTokenException();
        }
        if (!storedToken.getExpiresAt().isAfter(now)) {
            storedToken.revoke(now);
            throw new InvalidRefreshTokenException();
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

```java
public static UserProfileResponse fromEntity(User user)
{
        CustomerProfile profile = user.getCustomerProfile();
        List<String> roles = user.getRoles().stream()
                .map(role -> role.getCode())
                .sorted()
                .toList();
        return new UserProfileResponse(
                user.getId(),
                user.getEmail(),
                user.getDisplayName(),
                user.getPhoneNumber(),
                user.getStatus().name(),
                user.isEmailVerified(),
                profile == null ? null : profile.getDateOfBirth(),
                profile == null ? null : profile.getPreferredLanguage(),
                null,
                null,
                roles,
                user.getCreatedAt(),
                user.getUpdatedAt()
        );
    }
```

## identity-service · UserContextService.user

Nguồn: [UserContextService.java:20](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/user/UserContextService.java#L20). Kiểu trả về `Map<String, Object>`.

```java
public Map<String, Object> user(UUID id)
{
        Map<String, Object> profile = jdbc.sql(
                        "SELECT id,email,display_name AS \"displayName\",phone_number AS"
                            + " \"phoneNumber\",status FROM users WHERE id=:id AND status='ACTIVE'")
                .param("id", id)
                .query(
                        (row, n) -> {
                            Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
                            result.put("id", row.getObject("id"));
                            result.put("email", row.getString("email"));
                            result.put("displayName", row.getString("displayName"));
                            result.put("phoneNumber", row.getString("phoneNumber"));
                            result.put("status", row.getString("status"));
                            return result;
                        })
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("User not found"));
        List<String> roles = jdbc.sql("SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id=ur.role_id"
                        + " WHERE ur.user_id=:id ORDER BY r.code")
                .param("id", id).query(String.class).list();
        profile.put("roles", roles);
        return profile;
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`, `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`

## identity-service · UserContextService.address

Nguồn: [UserContextService.java:44](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/user/UserContextService.java#L44). Kiểu trả về `Map<String, Object>`.

```java
public Map<String, Object> address(UUID userId, UUID addressId)
{
        user(userId);
        return jdbc.sql(
                        "SELECT"
                            + " recipient_name,recipient_phone,address_line,ward,district,city,latitude,longitude"
                            + " FROM user_addresses WHERE id=:id AND user_id=:userId")
                .param("id", addressId)
                .param("userId", userId)
                .query(
                        (row, n) -> {
                            Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
                            for (String field :
                                    List.of(
                                            "recipient_name",
                                            "recipient_phone",
                                            "address_line",
                                            "ward",
                                            "district",
                                            "city",
                                            "latitude",
                                            "longitude")) {
                                String[] parts = field.split("_");
                                String key = parts[0];
                                for (int i = 1; i < parts.length; i++)
                                    key +=
                                            parts[i].substring(0, 1).toUpperCase()
                                                    + parts[i].substring(1);
                                result.put(key, row.getObject(field));
                            }
                            return result;
                        })
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Address not found"));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`, `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`

## identity-service · UserContextService.grantBakeryOwner

Nguồn: [UserContextService.java:79](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/feature/user/UserContextService.java#L79). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
@Transactional
    public void grantBakeryOwner(UUID userId)
{
        if (!((List<?>) user(userId).get("roles")).contains("CUSTOMER")) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException("Active customer not found");
        }
        jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id)
                SELECT :userId, id FROM roles WHERE code = 'BAKERY_OWNER'
                ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
                """).param("userId", userId).update();
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`, `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`

## identity-service · CorrelationFilter.doFilterInternal

Nguồn: [CorrelationFilter.java:15](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/infrastructure/CorrelationFilter.java#L15). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
@Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(
            HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, FilterChain chain)
            throws ServletException, IOException
{
        String correlation = request.getHeader("X-Correlation-Id");
        try {
            correlation = UUID.fromString(correlation).toString();
        } catch (Exception invalid) {
            correlation = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        }
        response.setHeader("X-Correlation-Id", correlation);
        MDC.put("correlationId", correlation);
        try {
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
        } finally {
            MDC.remove("correlationId");
        }
    }
```

## identity-service · CustomUserDetailsService.loadUserByUsername

```java
@Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public UserDetails loadUserByUsername(String email) throws UsernameNotFoundException
{
        User user = userRepository.findByEmail(normalizeEmail(email))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new UsernameNotFoundException(INVALID_CREDENTIALS));
        return UserPrincipal.from(user);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## identity-service · UserPrincipal.from

Nguồn: [UserPrincipal.java:35](../../../backend/identity-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/identityservice/security/UserPrincipal.java#L35). Kiểu trả về `UserPrincipal`.

```java
public static UserPrincipal from(User user)
{
        List<GrantedAuthority> authorities = user.getRoles().stream()
                .map(role -> (GrantedAuthority) new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + role.getCode()))
                .toList();
        return new UserPrincipal(
                user.getId(),
                user.getEmail(),
                user.getPasswordHash(),
                user.getStatus(),
                authorities
        );
    }
```

```java
public static ResultPaginationDTO fromPage(Page<?> page)
{

                page.getNumber() + 1,
                page.getSize(),

    }
```

## marketplace-service · CakeRequestData.configuration

Nguồn: [CakeRequestData.java:25](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/CakeRequestData.java#L25). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
public void configuration(UUID id, CreateCakeRequestRequest command, Quote quote)
{
        if (command.preference() == null) preferences.deleteById(id);
        else {
            var c = command.preference();
            var p = preferences.findById(id).orElseGet(CakePreference::create);
            p.setCakeRequestId(id);
            p.setCakeSize(c.cakeSize());
            p.setCakeShape(c.cakeShape());
            p.setFlavor(c.flavor());
            p.setFilling(c.filling());
            p.setFrosting(c.frosting());
            p.setColorPalette(c.colorPalette());
            p.setDecorationNotes(c.decorationNotes());
            p.setAllergyNotes(c.allergyNotes());
            p.setExtraOptions(c.extraOptions() == null ? Map.of() : c.extraOptions());
            preferences.save(p);
        }
        options.deleteByCakeRequestId(id);
        options.flush();
        if (quote != null)
            for (var snapshot : quote.options()) {
                var o = RequestOptionSelection.create();
                o.setId(UUID.randomUUID());
                o.setCakeRequestId(id);
                o.setOptionGroupId(snapshot.optionGroupId());
                o.setOptionValueId(snapshot.optionValueId());
                o.setGroupNameSnapshot(snapshot.groupNameSnapshot());
                o.setValueNameSnapshot(snapshot.valueNameSnapshot());
                o.setQuantity(snapshot.quantity());
                options.save(o);
            }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

<a id="m1122"></a>

## marketplace-service · CakeRequestData.history

Nguồn: [CakeRequestData.java:58](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/CakeRequestData.java#L58). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
public void history(
            CakeRequest request,
            RequestStatus previous,
            UUID actor,
            String reason,
            java.time.Instant now)
{
        var history = RequestStatusHistory.create();
        history.setId(UUID.randomUUID());
        history.setCakeRequestId(request.getId());
        history.setFromStatus(previous == null ? null : previous.name());
        history.setToStatus(request.getStatus().name());
        history.setChangedBy(actor);
        history.setReason(reason);
        history.setChangedAt(now);
        histories.save(history);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

```java
public CreateCakeRequestRequest command(
            CakeRequest request, CakePreference preference, List<RequestOptionSelection> options)
{
        return new CreateCakeRequestRequest(
                request.getRequestType(),
                request.getTargetBakeryId(),
                request.getBaseProductId(),
                request.getTitle(),
                request.getDescription(),
                request.getOccasion(),
                request.getServingSize(),
                request.getBudgetMin(),
                request.getBudgetMax(),
                request.getNeededAt(),
                request.getDeliveryDistrict(),
                request.getDeliveryCity(),
                request.getOfferDeadline(),
                preference(preference),
                options.stream()
                        .map(
                                o ->
                                        new com.se193262.marketplaceservice.infrastructure.client
                                                .CatalogContracts.Option(
                                                o.getOptionGroupId(),
                                                o.getOptionValueId(),
                                                o.getQuantity()))
                        .toList());
    }
```

```java
public CakeRequestResponse detail(CakeRequest request)
{
        Actor actor = Actor.current();
        boolean allOffers = actor.admin() || request.getCustomerId().equals(actor.id());
        Set<UUID> ids =
                allOffers
                        ? Set.of()
                        : bakery.memberships(actor.id()).stream()
                                .map(m -> m.bakeryId())
                                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toSet());
        var summaries =
                (allOffers
                                ? offers.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(
                                        request.getId())
                                : offers.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdAndBakeryIdInOrderByCreatedAtDesc(
                                        request.getId(), ids))
                        .stream()
                                .map(
                                        o ->
                                                new CakeRequestResponse.OfferSummary(
                                                        o.getId(),
                                                        o.getBakeryId(),
                                                        o.getStatus(),
                                                        o.getTotalPrice(),
                                                        o.getExpiresAt()))
                                .toList();
        var imageResponses =
                images.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdOrderByDisplayOrderAsc(request.getId()).stream()
                        .map(this::image)
                        .toList();
        return mapper.detail(
                request,
                preferences.findById(request.getId()).orElse(null),
                options.findByCakeRequestIdOrderByIdAsc(request.getId()),
                imageResponses,
                history.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdOrderByChangedAtDesc(request.getId()),
                summaries);
    }
```

## marketplace-service · CakeRequestRules.validate

Nguồn: [CakeRequestRules.java:26](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/CakeRequestRules.java#L26). Kiểu trả về `Quote`.

```java
public Quote validate(CreateCakeRequestRequest command)
{
        if (!validator.validate(command).isEmpty())
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Invalid request fields");
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        if (!command.neededAt().isAfter(now)
                || command.offerDeadline() != null
                        && (!command.offerDeadline().isAfter(now)
                                || !command.offerDeadline().isBefore(command.neededAt())))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Invalid request deadline");
        if (command.budgetMin() != null
                && command.budgetMax() != null
                && command.budgetMin().compareTo(command.budgetMax()) > 0)
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Invalid budget range");
        if (command.requestType() == RequestType.OPEN_CUSTOM) {
            if (command.targetBakeryId() != null
                    || command.baseProductId() != null
                    || command.optionSelections() != null && !command.optionSelections().isEmpty())
                throw BusinessException.invalid("Open request cannot have product selections");
            return null;
        }
        if (command.targetBakeryId() == null || command.baseProductId() == null)
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Target bakery and product required");
        Quote quote =
                bakery.quote(
                        new QuoteRequest(
                                command.targetBakeryId(),
                                command.baseProductId(),
                                command.deliveryCity(),
                                command.deliveryDistrict(),
                                command.optionSelections(),
                                List.of()));
        if (!quote.customizable()
                || command.neededAt()
                        .isBefore(now.plus(Duration.ofHours(quote.minimumNoticeHours()))))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Product cannot fulfill customization");
        return quote;
    }
```

## marketplace-service · CakeRequestServiceImpl.create

Nguồn: [CakeRequestServiceImpl.java:62](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/CakeRequestServiceImpl.java#L62). Kiểu trả về `CakeRequestResponse`.

```java
@Transactional
    public CakeRequestResponse create(CreateCakeRequestRequest command)
{
        Actor actor = Actor.current();
        if (!actor.customer()) throw BusinessException.forbidden();
        var quote = rules.validate(command);
        var request = CakeRequest.create();
        request.setId(UUID.randomUUID());
        request.setCustomerId(actor.id());
        mapper.apply(request, command);
        request.setStatus(RequestStatus.DRAFT);
        request.setCreatedAt(clock.instant());
        access.touch(request, clock.instant());
        requests.saveAndFlush(request);
        data.configuration(request.getId(), command, quote);
        data.history(request, null, actor.id(), null, clock.instant());
        return reader.detail(request);
    }
```

## marketplace-service · CakeRequestServiceImpl.patch

Nguồn: [CakeRequestServiceImpl.java:80](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/CakeRequestServiceImpl.java#L80). Kiểu trả về `CakeRequestResponse`.

```java
@Transactional
    public CakeRequestResponse patch(UUID id, PatchCakeRequestRequest patch)
{
        var actor = Actor.current();
        var request = reader.request(id);
        access.draft(request, actor);
        var changes = patch.changes();
        if (changes == null || changes.isEmpty())
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Patch is empty");
        var current = reader.command(request);
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> merged = json.convertValue(current, Map.class);
        if (!merged.keySet().containsAll(changes.keySet()))
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Unsupported patch field");
        merged.putAll(changes);
        CreateCakeRequestRequest command;
        try {
            command = json.convertValue(merged, CreateCakeRequestRequest.class);
        } catch (Exception error) {
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid patch");
        }
        if (command.requestType() != request.getRequestType()
                && (!images.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdOrderByDisplayOrderAsc(id).isEmpty()
                        || offers.existsByCakeRequestId(id)
                        || ai.hasJobs(id))) throw BusinessException.conflict();
        var quote = rules.validate(command);
        mapper.apply(request, command);
        access.touch(request, clock.instant());
        data.configuration(id, command, quote);
        requests.flush();
        return reader.detail(request);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## marketplace-service · CakeRequestServiceImpl.list

Nguồn: [CakeRequestServiceImpl.java:126](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/CakeRequestServiceImpl.java#L126). Kiểu trả về `PageResponse<CakeRequestSummaryResponse>`.

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResponse<CakeRequestSummaryResponse> list(Map<String, String> filters)
{
        var actor = Actor.current();
        String scope =
                filters.getOrDefault(
                        "scope", actor.customer() ? "mine" : actor.bakery() ? "available" : null);
        Specification<CakeRequest> specification = access.visible(actor, scope);
        for (String field :
                List.of("status", "requestType", "city", "district", "neededFrom", "neededTo")) {
            String value = filters.get(field);
            if (value == null) continue;
            specification =
                    specification.and(
                            (root, query, b) ->
                                    switch (field) {
                                        case "status" ->
                                                b.equal(
                                                        root.get("status"),
                                                        RequestStatus.valueOf(value));
                                        case "requestType" ->
                                                b.equal(
                                                        root.get("requestType"),
                                                        RequestType.valueOf(value));
                                        case "city" ->
                                                b.equal(
                                                        b.lower(root.get("deliveryCity")),
                                                        value.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
                                        case "district" ->
                                                b.equal(
                                                        b.lower(root.get("deliveryDistrict")),
                                                        value.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
                                        case "neededFrom" ->
                                                b.greaterThanOrEqualTo(
                                                        root.get("neededAt"), Instant.parse(value));
                                        default ->
                                                b.lessThanOrEqualTo(
                                                        root.get("neededAt"), Instant.parse(value));
                                    });
        }
        return PageResponse.from(
                requests.findAll(
                                specification,
                                QueryPaging.page(
                                        filters,
                                        Set.of("createdAt", "neededAt", "budgetMin", "budgetMax")))
                        .map(mapper::summary));
    }
```

## marketplace-service · CakeRequestServiceImpl.cancel

Nguồn: [CakeRequestServiceImpl.java:187](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/CakeRequestServiceImpl.java#L187). Kiểu trả về `CakeRequestResponse`.

```java
@Transactional
    public CakeRequestResponse cancel(UUID id, String reason)
{
        var actor = Actor.current();
        var request = reader.request(id);
        access.owner(request, actor);
        access.mutable(request);
        if (request.getStatus() != RequestStatus.DRAFT && request.getStatus() != RequestStatus.OPEN)
            throw BusinessException.conflict();
        var previous = request.getStatus();
        request.setStatus(RequestStatus.CANCELLED);
        access.touch(request, clock.instant());
        transitions.pendingTo(id, null, OfferStatus.REJECTED, actor.id(), reason);
        data.history(request, previous, actor.id(), reason, clock.instant());
        requests.flush();
        return reader.detail(request);
    }
```

## marketplace-service · CakeRequestServiceImpl.selectDesign

```java
@Transactional
    public CakeRequestResponse selectDesign(UUID id, UUID designId)
{
        var actor = Actor.current();
        var request = reader.request(id);
        access.owner(request, actor);
        access.mutable(request);
        if (request.getStatus() == RequestStatus.CLOSED
                || request.getStatus() == RequestStatus.CANCELLED)
            throw BusinessException.conflict();
        var design = ai.validate(designId, actor.id(), id);
        if (!design.exists()
                || !design.ownerMatches()
                || !design.requestMatches()
                || !"APPROVED".equals(design.moderationStatus())
                || !"SUCCEEDED".equals(design.jobStatus()))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Design cannot be selected");
        request.setSelectedDesignId(designId);
        access.touch(request, clock.instant());
        requests.flush();
        return reader.detail(request);
    }
```

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Map<String, Object> context(UUID id)
{

        Map<String, Object> context = new HashMap<>();
        context.put("id", id);
        context.put("customerId", request.getCustomerId());
        context.put("targetBakeryId", request.getTargetBakeryId());
        context.put("status", request.getStatus());
        context.put(
                "chatEligible",
                request.getStatus() != RequestStatus.DRAFT
                        && request.getStatus() != RequestStatus.CANCELLED);
        context.put(
                "aiEligible",
                request.getStatus() == RequestStatus.DRAFT
                        || request.getStatus() == RequestStatus.OPEN);
        return context;
    }
```

```java
public void touch(CakeRequest request, java.time.Instant now)
{
        // Keep the aggregate dirty even when two commands observe the same clock tick.
        var previous = request.getUpdatedAt();
        request.setUpdatedAt(
                previous != null && !now.isAfter(previous) ? previous.plusNanos(1000) : now);
    }
```

## marketplace-service · MarketplaceAccess.visible

Nguồn: [MarketplaceAccess.java:58](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/MarketplaceAccess.java#L58). Kiểu trả về `Specification<CakeRequest>`.

```java
public Specification<CakeRequest> visible(Actor actor, String scope)
{
        if (actor.admin()) return (root, query, builder) -> builder.conjunction();
        if (scope != null && !Set.of("mine", "available").contains(scope))
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid scope");
        if ("mine".equals(scope) && !actor.customer()
                || "available".equals(scope) && !actor.bakery())
            throw BusinessException.forbidden();
        var memberships =
                actor.bakery() && !"mine".equals(scope)
                        ? bakery.memberships(actor.id()).stream()
                                .filter(m -> m.active() && m.authorized() && "OWNER".equals(m.memberRole()))
                                .toList()
                        : List
                                .<com.se193262.marketplaceservice.infrastructure.client
                                                .CatalogContracts.Membership>
                                        of();
        var profiles = memberships.stream().map(m -> bakery.bakery(m.bakeryId())).toList();
        return (root, query, builder) -> {
            List<Predicate> permissions = new ArrayList<>();
            if (actor.customer() && !"available".equals(scope))
                permissions.add(builder.equal(root.get("customerId"), actor.id()));
            for (var profile : profiles) {
                List<Predicate> areas = new ArrayList<>();
                for (var area : profile.serviceAreas())
                    areas.add(
                            builder.and(
                                    builder.equal(
                                            builder.lower(root.get("deliveryCity")),
                                            area.city().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)),
                                    builder.equal(
                                            builder.lower(root.get("deliveryDistrict")),
                                            area.district().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))));
                var eligible =
                        builder.and(
                                builder.equal(root.get("status"), RequestStatus.OPEN),
                                builder.or(
                                        builder.equal(root.get("targetBakeryId"), profile.id()),
                                        builder.and(
                                                builder.isNull(root.get("targetBakeryId")),
                                                builder.or(areas.toArray(Predicate[]::new)))));
                var participated = query.subquery(UUID.class);
                var offer = participated.from(Offer.class);
                participated
                        .select(offer.get("cakeRequestId"))
                        .where(builder.equal(offer.get("bakeryId"), profile.id()));
                if (!"ACTIVE".equals(profile.status())) eligible = builder.disjunction();
                permissions.add(
                        "available".equals(scope)
                                ? eligible
                                : builder.or(eligible, root.get("id").in(participated)));
            }
            return builder.or(permissions.toArray(Predicate[]::new));
        };
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

## marketplace-service · MarketplaceChatAuthorizationService.authorize

Nguồn: [MarketplaceChatAuthorizationService.java:27](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/MarketplaceChatAuthorizationService.java#L27). Kiểu trả về `ChatAuthorizationResponse`.

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ChatAuthorizationResponse authorize(UUID cakeRequestId, UUID customerId, UUID bakeryId)
{
        CakeRequest request = requests.findById(cakeRequestId)
                .orElseThrow(BusinessException::missing);
        RequestStatus status = request.getStatus();
        boolean chatEligible = status != RequestStatus.DRAFT && status != RequestStatus.CANCELLED;
        boolean bakeryEligible = bakeryId.equals(request.getTargetBakeryId())
                || hasEligibleOffer(cakeRequestId, bakeryId, status);
        boolean authorized = chatEligible
                && customerId.equals(request.getCustomerId())
                && bakeryEligible;
        return new ChatAuthorizationResponse(cakeRequestId, customerId, bakeryId, status, authorized);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## marketplace-service · MarketplaceChatAuthorizationService.hasEligibleOffer

Nguồn: [MarketplaceChatAuthorizationService.java:41](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/MarketplaceChatAuthorizationService.java#L41). Kiểu trả về `boolean`.

```java
private boolean hasEligibleOffer(UUID cakeRequestId, UUID bakeryId, RequestStatus requestStatus)
{
        return switch (requestStatus) {
            case OPEN -> offers.existsByCakeRequestIdAndBakeryIdAndStatusAndExpiresAtAfter(
                    cakeRequestId, bakeryId, OfferStatus.PENDING, clock.instant());
            case OFFER_SELECTED, CLOSED -> offers.existsByCakeRequestIdAndBakeryIdAndStatus(
                    cakeRequestId, bakeryId, OfferStatus.ACCEPTED);
            case DRAFT, CANCELLED -> false;
        };
    }
```

## marketplace-service · RequestImageServiceImpl.upload

Nguồn: [RequestImageServiceImpl.java:42](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/RequestImageServiceImpl.java#L42). Kiểu trả về `List<RequestImageResponse>`.

```java
public List<RequestImageResponse> upload(
            UUID requestId, List<MultipartFile> files, List<Integer> displayOrder)
{
        if (files == null
                || files.isEmpty()
                || files.size() > 10
                || displayOrder != null && displayOrder.size() != files.size())
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid file count or order");
        Actor actor = Actor.current();
        transaction.executeWithoutResult(status -> access.draft(reader.request(requestId), actor));
        List<RequestImage> pending = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            for (int index = 0; index < files.size(); index++) {
                var file = files.get(index);
                if (file.getSize() == 0 || file.getSize() > 10L * 1024 * 1024)
                    throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid file size");
                byte[] bytes;
                try {
                    bytes = file.getBytes();
                } catch (java.io.IOException error) {
                    throw new BusinessException(400, "Cannot read file");
                }
                String type = mediaType(bytes),
                        extension =
                                type.equals("image/jpeg")
                                        ? "jpg"
                                        : type.equals("image/png") ? "png" : "webp";
                var image = RequestImage.create();
                image.setId(UUID.randomUUID());
                image.setCakeRequestId(requestId);
                image.setObjectKey(
                        "marketplace/requests/"
                                + requestId
                                + "/"
                                + image.getId()
                                + "."
                                + extension);
                image.setMediaType(type);
                image.setSizeBytes((long) bytes.length);
                image.setDisplayOrder(displayOrder == null ? index : displayOrder.get(index));
                image.setCreatedAt(clock.instant());
                if (image.getDisplayOrder() < 0)
                    throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid display order");
                pending.add(image);
                storage.upload(image.getObjectKey(), bytes, type);
            }
            transaction.executeWithoutResult(
                    status -> {
                        var request = reader.request(requestId);
                        access.draft(request, actor);
                        access.touch(request, clock.instant());
                        images.saveAllAndFlush(pending);
                    });
        } catch (RuntimeException error) {
            pending.forEach(image -> safeDelete(image.getObjectKey()));
            throw error;
        }
        return pending.stream().map(reader::image).toList();
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

<a id="m1192"></a>

## marketplace-service · RequestImageServiceImpl.delete

Nguồn: [RequestImageServiceImpl.java:101](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/RequestImageServiceImpl.java#L101). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
public void delete(UUID requestId, UUID imageId)
{
        Actor actor = Actor.current();
        String key =
                transaction.execute(
                        status -> {
                            var request = reader.request(requestId);
                            access.draft(request, actor);
                            var image =
                                    images.findById(imageId)
                                            .filter(i -> i.getCakeRequestId().equals(requestId))
                                            .orElseThrow(BusinessException::missing);
                            access.touch(request, clock.instant());
                            images.delete(image);
                            return image.getObjectKey();
                        });
        safeDelete(key);
    }
```

## marketplace-service · RequestImageServiceImpl.mediaType

Nguồn: [RequestImageServiceImpl.java:127](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/cakerequest/RequestImageServiceImpl.java#L127). Kiểu trả về `String`.

```java
static String mediaType(byte[] bytes)
{
        if (bytes.length >= 8
                && bytes[0] == (byte) 137
                && bytes[1] == 80
                && bytes[2] == 78
                && bytes[3] == 71
                && bytes[4] == 13
                && bytes[5] == 10
                && bytes[6] == 26
                && bytes[7] == 10) return "image/png";
        if (bytes.length >= 3
                && bytes[0] == (byte) 255
                && bytes[1] == (byte) 216
                && bytes[2] == (byte) 255) return "image/jpeg";
        if (bytes.length >= 12
                && new String(bytes, 0, 4, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
                        .equals("RIFF")
                && new String(bytes, 8, 4, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
                        .equals("WEBP")) return "image/webp";
        throw new BusinessException(400, "Unsupported image content");
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

```java
public void cleanOrphans()
{
        for (var object : storage.scan(100))
            if (object.createdAt().isBefore(clock.instant().minus(Duration.ofHours(24)))
                    && !images.existsByObjectKey(object.key())) safeDelete(object.key());
    }
```

## marketplace-service · AcceptanceTransactions.reserve

Nguồn: [AcceptanceTransactions.java:44](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/AcceptanceTransactions.java#L44). Kiểu trả về `OfferAcceptanceWorkflow`.

```java
@Transactional
    public OfferAcceptanceWorkflow reserve(
            UUID offerId, String key, AcceptOfferRequest command, Actor actor)
{
        if (!actor.customer()) throw BusinessException.forbidden();
        if (key == null || !key.matches("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}"))
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid Idempotency-Key");
        String fingerprint = fingerprint(offerId, command);
        var existing = workflows.findByCustomerIdAndIdempotencyKey(actor.id(), key);
        if (existing.isPresent()) {
            if (!existing.get().getPayloadFingerprint().equals(fingerprint))
                throw BusinessException.conflict();
            return existing.get();
        }
        var offer = offers.findById(offerId).orElseThrow(BusinessException::missing);
        var request = requests.request(offer.getCakeRequestId());
        access.owner(request, actor);
        access.mutable(request);
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        if (offer.getStatus() != OfferStatus.PENDING
                || !offer.getExpiresAt().isAfter(now)
                || request.getStatus() != RequestStatus.OPEN
                || !request.getNeededAt().isAfter(now)) throw BusinessException.conflict();
        access.touch(request, now);
        offer.setUpdatedAt(now);
        var workflow = OfferAcceptanceWorkflow.create();
        workflow.setId(UUID.randomUUID());
        workflow.setCakeRequestId(request.getId());
        workflow.setOfferId(offerId);
        workflow.setCustomerId(actor.id());
        workflow.setIdempotencyKey(key);
        workflow.setPayloadFingerprint(fingerprint);
        workflow.setDeliveryAddressId(command.deliveryAddressId());
        workflow.setCustomerNote(command.customerNote());
        workflow.setStatus(AcceptanceStatus.PREPARED);
        workflow.setAttemptCount(0);
        workflow.setNextRetryAt(now);
        workflow.setCreatedAt(now);
        workflow.setUpdatedAt(now);
        return workflows.saveAndFlush(workflow);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

<a id="m1234"></a>

## marketplace-service · AcceptanceTransactions.fingerprint

Nguồn: [AcceptanceTransactions.java:85](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/AcceptanceTransactions.java#L85). Kiểu trả về `String`.

```java
static String fingerprint(UUID offer, AcceptOfferRequest command)
{
        try {
            String note = command.customerNote();
            return HexFormat.of()
                    .formatHex(
                            MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                                    .digest(
                                            (offer
                                                            + "|"
                                                            + command.deliveryAddressId()
                                                            + "|"
                                                            + (note == null
                                                                    ? "-1:"
                                                                    : note.length() + ":" + note))
                                                    .getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(impossible);
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

## marketplace-service · AcceptanceTransactions.claim

Nguồn: [AcceptanceTransactions.java:105](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/AcceptanceTransactions.java#L105). Kiểu trả về `OfferAcceptanceWorkflow`.

```java
@Transactional
    public OfferAcceptanceWorkflow claim(UUID id, UUID owner)
{
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        int claimed =
                workflows.claim(
                        id,
                        owner,
                        now.plusSeconds(30),
                        now,
                        List.of(AcceptanceStatus.PREPARED, AcceptanceStatus.RETRYING));
        if (claimed == 0) return null;
        return workflows.findById(id).orElseThrow();
    }
```

## marketplace-service · AcceptanceTransactions.complete

Nguồn: [AcceptanceTransactions.java:119](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/AcceptanceTransactions.java#L119). Kiểu trả về `AcceptanceResponse`.

```java
@Transactional
    public AcceptanceResponse complete(UUID id, UUID owner, OrderResult result)
{
        var workflow = workflows.findById(id).orElseThrow();
        if (workflow.getStatus() == AcceptanceStatus.SUCCEEDED) return response(workflow);
        if (!owner.equals(workflow.getLeaseOwner())) throw BusinessException.unavailable();
        var request = requests.request(workflow.getCakeRequestId());
        var selected = offers.findById(workflow.getOfferId()).orElseThrow();
        transitions.change(
                selected, OfferStatus.ACCEPTED, workflow.getCustomerId(), "Offer accepted");
        transitions.pendingTo(
                request.getId(),
                selected.getId(),
                OfferStatus.REJECTED,
                workflow.getCustomerId(),
                "Another offer accepted");
        var previous = request.getStatus();
        request.setStatus(RequestStatus.OFFER_SELECTED);
        access.touch(request, clock.instant());
        requestData.history(
                request, previous, workflow.getCustomerId(), "Offer accepted", clock.instant());
        workflow.setStatus(AcceptanceStatus.SUCCEEDED);
        workflow.setOrderId(result.orderId());
        workflow.setOrderNumber(result.orderNumber());
        workflow.setLeaseOwner(null);
        workflow.setLeaseUntil(null);
        workflow.setUpdatedAt(clock.instant());
        workflows.flush();
        return response(workflow);
    }
```

## marketplace-service · AcceptanceTransactions.failure

Nguồn: [AcceptanceTransactions.java:149](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/AcceptanceTransactions.java#L149). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
@Transactional
    public void failure(UUID id, UUID owner, int status)
{
        var workflow = workflows.findById(id).orElseThrow();
        if (!owner.equals(workflow.getLeaseOwner())
                || workflow.getStatus() == AcceptanceStatus.SUCCEEDED) return;
        workflow.setAttemptCount(workflow.getAttemptCount() + 1);
        workflow.setUpdatedAt(clock.instant());
        workflow.setLeaseOwner(null);
        workflow.setLeaseUntil(null);
        if (status == 422 || status == 404) {
            workflow.setStatus(AcceptanceStatus.FAILED);
            workflow.setErrorStatus(status);
        } else {
            workflow.setStatus(AcceptanceStatus.RETRYING);
            workflow.setNextRetryAt(
                    clock.instant()
                            .plusSeconds(
                                    Math.min(300, 1L << Math.min(workflow.getAttemptCount(), 8))));
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

```java
@Transactional
    public void expireOffer(UUID id)
{
        var offer = offers.findById(id).orElseThrow();
        var request = requests.findById(offer.getCakeRequestId()).orElseThrow();
        access.mutable(request);
        if (offer.getStatus() == OfferStatus.PENDING
                && !offer.getExpiresAt().isAfter(clock.instant())) {
            access.touch(request, clock.instant());
            transitions.change(
                    offer, OfferStatus.EXPIRED, request.getCustomerId(), "Offer expired");
        }
    }
```

## marketplace-service · MarketplaceExpirationService.closeRequest

Nguồn: [MarketplaceExpirationService.java:48](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/MarketplaceExpirationService.java#L48). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
@Transactional
    public void closeRequest(UUID id)
{
        var request = requests.findById(id).orElseThrow();
        access.mutable(request);
        if (request.getStatus() != RequestStatus.OPEN
                || request.getNeededAt().isAfter(clock.instant())) return;
        request.setStatus(RequestStatus.CLOSED);
        access.touch(request, clock.instant());
        data.history(
                request,
                RequestStatus.OPEN,
                request.getCustomerId(),
                "Required delivery time passed",
                clock.instant());
        transitions.pendingTo(
                id, null, OfferStatus.EXPIRED, request.getCustomerId(), "Request closed");
    }
```

## marketplace-service · OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.accept

Nguồn: [OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.java:49](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.java#L49). Kiểu trả về `AcceptanceResponse`.

```java
public AcceptanceResponse accept(UUID offerId, String key, AcceptOfferRequest command)
{
        var workflow = transactions.reserve(offerId, key, command, Actor.current());
        if (workflow.getStatus() == AcceptanceStatus.SUCCEEDED)
            return AcceptanceTransactions.response(workflow);
        if (workflow.getStatus() == AcceptanceStatus.FAILED)
            throw new BusinessException(workflow.getErrorStatus(), "Acceptance validation failed");
        return execute(workflow.getId());
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

<a id="m1278"></a>

## marketplace-service · OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.execute

Nguồn: [OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.java:58](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.java#L58). Kiểu trả về `AcceptanceResponse`.

```java
private AcceptanceResponse execute(UUID id)
{
        UUID owner = UUID.randomUUID();
        var workflow = transactions.claim(id, owner);
        if (workflow == null) throw BusinessException.conflict();
        try {
            var result =
                    orders.create(
                            new OrderClient.CreateOrder(
                                    workflow.getOfferId(),
                                    workflow.getCakeRequestId(),
                                    workflow.getCustomerId(),
                                    workflow.getDeliveryAddressId(),
                                    workflow.getCustomerNote()));
            var response = transactions.complete(id, owner, result);
            log.info(
                    "Offer accepted: offerId={}, orderId={}",
                    workflow.getOfferId(),
                    result.orderId());
            return response;
        } catch (BusinessException error) {
            transactions.failure(id, owner, error.status());
            throw error;
        } catch (RuntimeException error) {
            transactions.failure(id, owner, 503);
            throw BusinessException.unavailable();
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

<a id="m1279"></a>

## marketplace-service · OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.orderSource

Nguồn: [OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.java:86](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.java#L86). Kiểu trả về `OfferOrderSource`.

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public OfferOrderSource orderSource(UUID offerId)
{
        var workflow =
                workflows
                        .findByOfferIdAndStatusIn(
                                offerId,
                                List.of(
                                        AcceptanceStatus.PREPARED,
                                        AcceptanceStatus.RETRYING,
                                        AcceptanceStatus.SUCCEEDED))
                        .orElseThrow(BusinessException::conflict);
        var offer = offers.findById(offerId).orElseThrow(BusinessException::missing);
        var request = requests.request(workflow.getCakeRequestId());
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> configuration = json.convertValue(requests.command(request), Map.class);
        configuration.put("selectedDesignId", request.getSelectedDesignId());
        return new OfferOrderSource(
                offerId,
                request.getId(),
                request.getCustomerId(),
                offer.getBakeryId(),
                request.getTitle(),
                request.getDescription(),
                request.getNeededAt(),
                request.getDeliveryCity(),
                request.getDeliveryDistrict(),
                offer.getCakePrice(),
                offer.getDeliveryFee(),
                offer.getAddOnTotal(),
                offer.getTotalPrice(),
                configuration,
                items.findByOfferIdOrderByIdAsc(offerId).stream()
                        .map(
                                i ->
                                        new OfferOrderSource.Item(
                                                i.getId(),
                                                i.getAddOnId(),
                                                i.getItemNameSnapshot(),
                                                i.getDescriptionSnapshot(),
                                                i.getQuantity(),
                                                i.getUnitPrice(),
                                                i.getLineTotal()))
                        .toList());
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

<a id="m1280"></a>

## marketplace-service · OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.recover

Nguồn: [OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.java:131](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferAcceptanceServiceImpl.java#L131). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
public void recover()
{
        for (var workflow :
                workflows.findTop100ByStatusInAndNextRetryAtBefore(
                        List.of(AcceptanceStatus.PREPARED, AcceptanceStatus.RETRYING),
                        clock.instant())) {
            try {
                execute(workflow.getId());
            } catch (RuntimeException error) {
                log.warn("Acceptance recovery deferred: workflowId={}", workflow.getId());
            }
        }
    }
```

## marketplace-service · OfferData.apply

Nguồn: [OfferData.java:51](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferData.java#L51). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
public void apply(Offer offer, CreateOfferRequest command, Quote quote)
{
        offer.setMessage(command.message());
        offer.setCakePrice(command.cakePrice());
        offer.setDeliveryFee(command.deliveryFee());
        offer.setEstimatedCompletionAt(command.estimatedCompletionAt());
        offer.setExpiresAt(command.expiresAt());
        offer.setAddOnTotal(quote.addOnTotal());
        offer.setTotalPrice(command.cakePrice().add(command.deliveryFee()).add(quote.addOnTotal()));
        items.deleteByOfferId(offer.getId());
        items.flush();
        for (var snapshot : quote.items()) {
            var item = OfferItem.create();
            item.setId(UUID.randomUUID());
            item.setOfferId(offer.getId());
            item.setAddOnId(snapshot.addOnId());
            item.setItemNameSnapshot(snapshot.itemNameSnapshot());
            item.setDescriptionSnapshot(snapshot.descriptionSnapshot());
            item.setQuantity(snapshot.quantity());
            item.setUnitPrice(snapshot.unitPrice());
            item.setLineTotal(snapshot.lineTotal());
            items.save(item);
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

## marketplace-service · OfferRules.validate

Nguồn: [OfferRules.java:32](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferRules.java#L32). Kiểu trả về `Quote`.

```java
public Quote validate(CakeRequest request, CreateOfferRequest command)
{
        if (!validator.validate(command).isEmpty())
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Invalid offer fields");
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        if (request.getStatus() != RequestStatus.OPEN
                || !request.getNeededAt().isAfter(now)
                || request.getOfferDeadline() != null && !request.getOfferDeadline().isAfter(now))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Request no longer accepting offers");
        if (request.getTargetBakeryId() != null
                && !request.getTargetBakeryId().equals(command.bakeryId()))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Wrong target bakery");
        if (!command.expiresAt().isAfter(now)
                || command.expiresAt().isAfter(request.getNeededAt())
                || !command.estimatedCompletionAt().isAfter(now)
                || command.estimatedCompletionAt().isAfter(request.getNeededAt()))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Invalid offer dates");
        if (!subscription.active(command.bakeryId()))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Active subscription required");
        Quote quote =
                bakery.quote(
                        new QuoteRequest(
                                command.bakeryId(),
                                null,
                                request.getDeliveryCity(),
                                request.getDeliveryDistrict(),
                                List.of(),
                                command.items()));
        if (command.cakePrice()
                        .add(command.deliveryFee())
                        .add(quote.addOnTotal())
                        .compareTo(new java.math.BigDecimal("9999999999.99"))
                > 0) throw BusinessException.invalid("Price exceeds supported range");
        return quote;
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`
