## marketplace-service · OfferServiceImpl.create

Nguồn: [OfferServiceImpl.java:53](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferServiceImpl.java#L53). Kiểu trả về `OfferResponse`.

```java
@Transactional
    public OfferResponse create(UUID requestId, CreateOfferRequest command)
{
        var actor = Actor.current();
        access.bakeryMember(command.bakeryId(), actor, false);
        var request = requests.request(requestId);
        access.mutable(request);
        if (offers.existsByCakeRequestIdAndBakeryId(requestId, command.bakeryId()))
            throw BusinessException.conflict();
        var quote = rules.validate(request, command);
        access.touch(request, clock.instant());
        var offer = Offer.create();
        offer.setId(UUID.randomUUID());
        offer.setCakeRequestId(requestId);
        offer.setBakeryId(command.bakeryId());
        offer.setCreatedAt(clock.instant());
        offer.setUpdatedAt(clock.instant());
        offer.setMessage(command.message());
        offer.setCakePrice(command.cakePrice());
        offer.setDeliveryFee(command.deliveryFee());
        offer.setAddOnTotal(quote.addOnTotal());
        offer.setTotalPrice(command.cakePrice().add(command.deliveryFee()).add(quote.addOnTotal()));
        offer.setEstimatedCompletionAt(command.estimatedCompletionAt());
        offer.setExpiresAt(command.expiresAt());
        offer.setStatus(OfferStatus.PENDING);
        offers.saveAndFlush(offer);
        data.apply(offer, command, quote);
        transitions.change(offer, OfferStatus.PENDING, actor.id(), "Submitted");
        offers.flush();
        return data.detail(offer);
    }
```

## marketplace-service · OfferServiceImpl.patch

Nguồn: [OfferServiceImpl.java:94](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferServiceImpl.java#L94). Kiểu trả về `OfferResponse`.

```java
@Transactional
    public OfferResponse patch(UUID id, PatchOfferRequest patch)
{
        var actor = Actor.current();
        var offer = offer(id);
        access.bakeryMember(offer.getBakeryId(), actor, true);
        pending(offer);
        var request = requests.request(offer.getCakeRequestId());
        access.mutable(request);
        if (patch.changes() == null
                || patch.changes().isEmpty()
                || patch.changes().containsKey("bakeryId"))
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid patch");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> merged = json.convertValue(data.command(offer), Map.class);
        if (!merged.keySet().containsAll(patch.changes().keySet()))
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Unsupported patch field");
        merged.putAll(patch.changes());
        CreateOfferRequest command;
        try {
            command = json.convertValue(merged, CreateOfferRequest.class);
        } catch (Exception error) {
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid patch");
        }
        var quote = rules.validate(request, command);
        data.apply(offer, command, quote);
        offer.setUpdatedAt(clock.instant());
        access.touch(request, clock.instant());
        offers.flush();
        return data.detail(offer);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## marketplace-service · OfferServiceImpl.list

Nguồn: [OfferServiceImpl.java:149](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferServiceImpl.java#L149). Kiểu trả về `PageResponse<OfferResponse>`.

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResponse<OfferResponse> list(Map<String, String> filters)
{
        var actor = Actor.current();
        String scope = filters.getOrDefault("scope", actor.customer() ? "received" : "sent");
        Specification<Offer> specification;
        if (actor.admin()) specification = (root, q, b) -> b.conjunction();
        else if (scope.equals("received") && actor.customer())
            specification =
                    (root, q, b) -> {
                        var sub = q.subquery(UUID.class);
                        var request = sub.from(CakeRequest.class);
                        sub.select(request.get("id"))
                                .where(b.equal(request.get("customerId"), actor.id()));
                        return root.get("cakeRequestId").in(sub);
                    };
        else if (scope.equals("sent") && actor.bakery()) {
            var ids = bakery.memberships(actor.id()).stream().map(m -> m.bakeryId()).toList();
            specification = (root, q, b) -> root.get("bakeryId").in(ids);
        } else throw BusinessException.forbidden();
        for (String field : List.of("cakeRequestId", "bakeryId", "status"))
            if (filters.containsKey(field)) {
                String value = filters.get(field);
                specification =
                        specification.and(
                                (root, q, b) ->
                                        b.equal(
                                                root.get(field),
                                                field.equals("status")
                                                        ? OfferStatus.valueOf(value)
                                                        : UUID.fromString(value)));
            }
        return PageResponse.from(
                offers.findAll(
                                specification,
                                QueryPaging.page(
                                        filters, Set.of("createdAt", "totalPrice", "expiresAt")))
                        .map(data::summary));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## marketplace-service · OfferTransitions.change

Nguồn: [OfferTransitions.java:21](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferTransitions.java#L21). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
public void change(Offer offer, OfferStatus status, UUID actor, String reason)
{
        var record = OfferStatusHistory.create();
        record.setId(UUID.randomUUID());
        record.setOfferId(offer.getId());
        record.setFromStatus(
                offer.getStatus() == null || "Submitted".equals(reason)
                        ? null
                        : offer.getStatus().name());
        record.setToStatus(status.name());
        record.setChangedBy(actor);
        record.setReason(reason);
        record.setChangedAt(clock.instant());
        offer.setStatus(status);
        offer.setUpdatedAt(clock.instant());
        history.save(record);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

## marketplace-service · OfferTransitions.pendingTo

Nguồn: [OfferTransitions.java:38](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/feature/offer/OfferTransitions.java#L38). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
public void pendingTo(
            UUID requestId, UUID except, OfferStatus status, UUID actor, String reason)
{
        while (true) {
            var batch =
                    offers.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdAndStatusAndIdNot(
                            requestId,
                            OfferStatus.PENDING,
                            except == null ? new UUID(0, 0) : except);
            if (batch.isEmpty()) return;
            batch.forEach(offer -> change(offer, status, actor, reason));
            offers.flush();
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

## marketplace-service · SubscriptionClient.active

Nguồn: [SubscriptionClient.java:25](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/infrastructure/client/SubscriptionClient.java#L25). Kiểu trả về `boolean`.

```java
public boolean active(UUID bakeryId)
{
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        var cached = cache.get(bakeryId);
        if (cached != null && now.isBefore(cached.expires())) return cached.entitlement().active();
        var value =
                http.get(
                        http.properties().subscriptionUrl(),
                        "/internal/v1/subscriptions/bakeries/" + bakeryId + "/entitlement",
                        "subscription-service",
                        "subscription:entitlement:read",
                        Entitlement.class);
        Instant expires = now.plusSeconds(60);
        if (value.periodEnd() != null && value.periodEnd().isBefore(expires))
            expires = value.periodEnd();
        if (cache.size() > 10000) cache.clear();
        cache.put(bakeryId, new Cached(value, expires));
        return value.active() && value.periodEnd() != null && now.isBefore(value.periodEnd());
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`

```java
{
```

```java
                offers.findTop100ByStatusAndExpiresAtBefore(OfferStatus.PENDING, clock.instant()))
            safe(() -> expiration.expireOffer(offer.getId()));
        for (var request :
                requests.findTop100ByStatusAndNeededAtBefore(RequestStatus.OPEN, clock.instant()))
            safe(() -> expiration.closeRequest(request.getId()));
    }
```

```java
private synchronized Storage storage()
{
        if (storage != null) return storage;
        try {
            if (properties.bucket() == null
                    || properties.bucket().isBlank()
                    || properties.projectId() == null
                    || properties.projectId().isBlank()) throw BusinessException.unavailable();
            var credentials = GoogleCredentials.getApplicationDefault();
            var options =
                    FirebaseOptions.builder()
                            .setCredentials(credentials)
                            .setProjectId(properties.projectId())
                            .setStorageBucket(properties.bucket())
                            .build();
            FirebaseApp.initializeApp(options, "marketplace-" + UUID.randomUUID());
            storage =
                    StorageOptions.newBuilder()
                            .setTransportOptions(
                                    com.google.cloud.http.HttpTransportOptions.newBuilder()
                                            .setConnectTimeout(
                                                    Math.toIntExact(
                                                            properties.connectTimeout().toMillis()))
                                            .setReadTimeout(
                                                    Math.toIntExact(
                                                            properties.readTimeout().toMillis()))
                                            .build())
                            .setCredentials(credentials)
                            .setProjectId(properties.projectId())
                            .build()
                            .getService();
            return storage;
        } catch (Exception error) {
            throw BusinessException.unavailable();
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties(FirebaseProperties.class)`

## marketplace-service · FirebaseStorageAdapter.scan

Nguồn: [FirebaseStorageAdapter.java:98](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/infrastructure/storage/FirebaseStorageAdapter.java#L98). Kiểu trả về `List<StoredObject>`.

```java
public synchronized List<StoredObject> scan(int limit)
{
        try {
            var options = new ArrayList<Storage.BlobListOption>();
            options.add(Storage.BlobListOption.prefix("marketplace/requests/"));
            options.add(Storage.BlobListOption.pageSize(limit));
            if (pageToken != null) options.add(Storage.BlobListOption.pageToken(pageToken));
            var page =
                    storage()
                            .list(
                                    properties.bucket(),
                                    options.toArray(Storage.BlobListOption[]::new));
            pageToken = page.getNextPageToken();
            List<StoredObject> result = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Blob blob : page.getValues())
                result.add(
                        new StoredObject(
                                blob.getName(), blob.getCreateTimeOffsetDateTime().toInstant()));
            return result;
        } catch (StorageException error) {
            throw BusinessException.unavailable();
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Component`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties(FirebaseProperties.class)`

## marketplace-service · QueryPaging.page

Nguồn: [QueryPaging.java:12](../../../backend/marketplace-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/marketplaceservice/shared/QueryPaging.java#L12). Kiểu trả về `Pageable`.

```java
public static Pageable page(Map<String, String> filters, Set<String> allowed)
{
        try {
            int page = Integer.parseInt(filters.getOrDefault("page", "1")),
                    size = Integer.parseInt(filters.getOrDefault("size", "20"));
            String[] sort = filters.getOrDefault("sort", "createdAt,desc").split(",");
            if (page < 1
                    || size < 1
                    || size > 100
                    || sort.length != 2
                    || !allowed.contains(sort[0])
                    || !Set.of("asc", "desc").contains(sort[1]))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            return PageRequest.of(
                    page - 1,
                    size,
                    Sort.by(Sort.Direction.fromString(sort[1]), sort[0]).and(Sort.by("id")));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
            throw new BusinessException(400, "Invalid pagination or sort");
        }
    }
```

## order-service · RestClientConfig.createClient

Nguồn: [RestClientConfig.java:59](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/config/RestClientConfig.java#L59). Kiểu trả về `T`.

```java
private <T> T createClient(
            ServiceClientProperties.Service service,
            ServiceClientProperties properties,
            Class<T> clientType,
            ServiceHttpClient serviceHttpClient)
{
        HttpClient httpClient = HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .connectTimeout(properties.connectTimeout())
                .build();
        JdkClientHttpRequestFactory requestFactory = new JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(httpClient);
        requestFactory.setReadTimeout(properties.readTimeout());

        RestClient restClient = RestClient.builder()
                .baseUrl(service.baseUrl())
                .requestFactory(requestFactory)
                .requestInterceptor((request, body, execution) -> {
                    String correlationId = MDC.get("correlationId");
                    request.getHeaders().set("X-Correlation-Id",
                            correlationId == null || correlationId.isBlank()
                                    ? UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                                    : correlationId);
                    request.getHeaders().setBearerAuth(
                            serviceHttpClient.serviceToken(service.audience(), service.scope()));
                    return execution.execute(request, body);
                })
                .build();
        HttpServiceProxyFactory proxyFactory = HttpServiceProxyFactory
                .builderFor(RestClientAdapter.create(restClient))
                .build();
        return proxyFactory.createClient(clientType);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties(ServiceClientProperties.class)`

## order-service · SecurityConfig.jwtDecoder

Nguồn: [SecurityConfig.java:50](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/config/SecurityConfig.java#L50). Kiểu trả về `JwtDecoder`.

```java
@Bean
    JwtDecoder jwtDecoder(JwtProperties properties)
{
        NimbusJwtDecoder decoder = NimbusJwtDecoder.withJwkSetUri(properties.jwkSetUri()).build();
        OAuth2TokenValidator<Jwt> audienceAndTypeValidator = jwt -> {
            String tokenType = jwt.getClaimAsString("token_type");
            String expectedAudience = switch (tokenType == null ? "" : tokenType) {
                case "user" -> properties.userAudience();
                case "service" -> properties.serviceAudience();
                default -> null;
            };
            return expectedAudience != null && jwt.getAudience().contains(expectedAudience)
                    ? OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.success()
                    : OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.failure(INVALID_TOKEN_CONTRACT);
        };
        decoder.setJwtValidator(new DelegatingOAuth2TokenValidator<>(
                new JwtTimestampValidator(),
                new JwtIssuerValidator(properties.issuer()),
                audienceAndTypeValidator));
        return decoder;
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties(JwtProperties.class)`

## order-service · SecurityConfig.jwtAuthenticationConverter

Nguồn: [SecurityConfig.java:71](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/config/SecurityConfig.java#L71). Kiểu trả về `Converter<Jwt, ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken>`.

```java
@Bean
    Converter<Jwt, ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken> jwtAuthenticationConverter()
{
        return jwt -> {
            Set<org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority> authorities = new LinkedHashSet<>();
            List<String> roles = jwt.getClaimAsStringList("roles");
            if (roles != null) {
                roles.stream()
                        .filter(role -> role != null && !role.isBlank())
                        .map(role -> new org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + role))
                        .forEach(authorities::add);
            }
            String scopes = jwt.getClaimAsString("scope");
            if (scopes != null) {
                for (String scope : scopes.trim().split("\\s+")) {
                    if (!scope.isBlank()) {
                        authorities.add(new org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority("SCOPE_" + scope));
                    }
                }
            }
            return new JwtAuthenticationToken(jwt, authorities, jwt.getSubject());
        };
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties(JwtProperties.class)`

```java
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(
            HttpSecurity http,
            Converter<Jwt, ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken> jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler
    ) throws Exception
{
        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .sessionManagement(session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(authorize -> authorize
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/v3/api-docs/**", "/v3/api-docs.yaml",
                                "/swagger-ui/**", "/swagger-ui.html").permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/internal/v1/orders/from-offer")
                        .access(serviceScope("order:create-from-offer"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/internal/v1/orders/*/context")
                        .access(serviceScope("order:context:read"))
                        .requestMatchers("/internal/v1/**").denyAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PATCH, "/api/v1/admin/reviews/**")
                        .access(userRole("ROLE_ADMIN"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/orders/direct",
                                "/api/v1/orders/*/review")
                        .access(userRole("ROLE_CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PATCH, "/api/v1/orders/*/review")
                        .access(userRole("ROLE_CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.DELETE, "/api/v1/orders/*/review")
                        .access(userRole("ROLE_CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/**").access(userToken())
                        .anyRequest().denyAll())
                .oauth2ResourceServer(resourceServer -> resourceServer
                        .jwt(jwt -> jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(jwtAuthenticationConverter))
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler))
                .exceptionHandling(exceptions -> exceptions
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler));
        return http.build();
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties(JwtProperties.class)`

```java
@Bean
    AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint(ObjectMapper objectMapper)
{
        return (request, response, exception) -> {
            response.setStatus(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED.value());
            response.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE);
            response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
            objectMapper.writeValue(response.getWriter(), ApiResponse.error(
                    HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED.value(), "Authentication is required or token is invalid"));
        };
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties(JwtProperties.class)`

## order-service · SecurityConfig.userRole

Nguồn: [SecurityConfig.java:159](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/config/SecurityConfig.java#L159). Kiểu trả về `AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext>`.

```java
private AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext> userRole(String requiredAuthority)
{
        return (authentication, context) -> {
            Authentication resolved = authentication.get();
            boolean allowed = resolved instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken jwtAuthentication
                    && resolved.isAuthenticated()
                    && "user".equals(jwtAuthentication.getToken().getClaimAsString("token_type"))
                    && hasAuthority(resolved, requiredAuthority);
            return new AuthorizationDecision(allowed);
        };
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`, `@EnableConfigurationProperties(JwtProperties.class)`

```java
private AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext> serviceScope(String requiredScope)
{
        return (authentication, context) -> {
            Authentication resolved = authentication.get();
            boolean allowed = resolved instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken jwtAuthentication
                    && resolved.isAuthenticated()
                    && "service".equals(jwtAuthentication.getToken().getClaimAsString("token_type"))
                    && hasAuthority(resolved, "SCOPE_" + requiredScope);
            return new AuthorizationDecision(allowed);
        };
    }
```

```java
            boolean allowed = resolved instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken jwtAuthentication
```

## order-service · SecurityConfig.hasAuthority

```java
private boolean hasAuthority(Authentication authentication, String requiredAuthority)
{
        return authentication.getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(authority -> requiredAuthority.equals(authority.getAuthority()));
    }
```

## order-service · CustomerOrder.create

Nguồn: [CustomerOrder.java:111](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/CustomerOrder.java#L111). Kiểu trả về `CustomerOrder`.

```java
static CustomerOrder create(
            UUID customerId,
            UUID bakeryId,
            UUID cakeRequestId,
            UUID offerId,
            OrderSource orderSource,
            String customerName,
            String customerPhone,
            String bakeryName,
            String customerNote,
            BigDecimal subtotal,
            BigDecimal deliveryFee,
            BigDecimal totalAmount,
            Instant neededAt,
            Instant now)
{
        CustomerOrder order = new CustomerOrder();
        order.orderNumber = "ORD-" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").substring(0, 20).toUpperCase();
        order.customerId = customerId;
        order.bakeryId = bakeryId;
        order.cakeRequestId = cakeRequestId;
        order.offerId = offerId;
        order.orderSource = orderSource;
        order.customerNameSnapshot = customerName;
        order.customerPhoneSnapshot = customerPhone;
        order.bakeryNameSnapshot = bakeryName;
        order.customerNote = customerNote;
        order.subtotal = subtotal;
        order.deliveryFee = deliveryFee;
        order.totalAmount = totalAmount;
        order.currency = "VND";
        order.status = OrderStatus.PENDING;
        order.neededAt = neededAt;
        order.createdAt = now;
        order.updatedAt = now;
        return order;
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Entity`, `@Table(name = "customer_orders")`

## order-service · CustomerOrder.transitionTo

Nguồn: [CustomerOrder.java:160](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/CustomerOrder.java#L160). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
void transitionTo(OrderStatus targetStatus, UUID changedBy, String note, Instant changedAt)
{
        boolean allowed = switch (status) {
            case PENDING -> targetStatus == OrderStatus.CONFIRMED || targetStatus == OrderStatus.CANCELLED;
            case CONFIRMED -> targetStatus == OrderStatus.BAKING || targetStatus == OrderStatus.CANCELLED;
            case BAKING -> targetStatus == OrderStatus.READY;
            case READY -> targetStatus == OrderStatus.DELIVERING;
            case DELIVERING -> targetStatus == OrderStatus.COMPLETED;
            case COMPLETED, CANCELLED -> false;
        };
        if (!allowed) {
            throw new OrderConflictException("Order cannot transition from " + status + " to " + targetStatus);
        }

        OrderStatus previousStatus = status;
        status = targetStatus;
        updatedAt = changedAt;
        if (targetStatus == OrderStatus.CONFIRMED && acceptedAt == null) {
            acceptedAt = changedAt;
        }
        if (targetStatus == OrderStatus.COMPLETED) {
            completedAt = changedAt;
        }
        statusHistory.add(OrderStatusHistory.transition(this, previousStatus, targetStatus, changedBy, note, changedAt));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Entity`, `@Table(name = "customer_orders")`

## order-service · OfferOrderRepository.existing

Nguồn: [OfferOrderRepository.java:27](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OfferOrderRepository.java#L27). Kiểu trả về `Optional<OrderCreationResponse>`.

```java
public Optional<OrderCreationResponse> existing(String key, String fingerprint, UUID offerId)
{
        var rows =
                jdbc.sql(
                                "select"
                                    + " c.idempotency_key,c.payload_fingerprint,o.id,o.order_number,o.status"
                                    + " from order_offer_creations c join customer_orders o on"
                                    + " o.offer_id=c.offer_id where c.idempotency_key=:key or"
                                    + " c.offer_id=:offerId")
                        .param("key", key)
                        .param("offerId", offerId)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();
        if (rows.isEmpty()) return Optional.empty();
        var row = rows.getFirst();
        if (rows.size() != 1
                || !key.equals(row.get("idempotency_key"))
                || !fingerprint.equals(row.get("payload_fingerprint")))
            throw BusinessException.conflict();
        return Optional.of(
                new OrderCreationResponse(
                        (UUID) row.get("id"),
                        (String) row.get("order_number"),
                        (String) row.get("status")));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Repository`

## order-service · OfferOrderRepository.save

Nguồn: [OfferOrderRepository.java:52](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OfferOrderRepository.java#L52). Kiểu trả về `OfferOrderService.Creation`.

```java
@Transactional
    public OfferOrderService.Creation save(
            String key,
            String fingerprint,
            CreateOfferOrderRequest command,
            OfferOrderSource source,
            Map<String, Object> user,
            Map<String, Object> bakery,
            Map<String, Object> address)
{
        var existing = existing(key, fingerprint, command.offerId());
        if (existing.isPresent()) return new OfferOrderService.Creation(existing.get(), false);
        UUID orderId = UUID.randomUUID();
        String number =
                "ORD-"
                        + LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneOffset.UTC).toString().replace("-", "")
                        + "-"
                        + orderId.toString().replace("-", "").substring(0, 20);
        Map<String, Object> order = new HashMap<>();
        order.put("id", orderId);
        order.put("order_number", number);
        order.put("customer_id", command.customerId());
        order.put("bakery_id", source.bakeryId());
        order.put("cake_request_id", command.cakeRequestId());
        order.put("offer_id", command.offerId());
        order.put("order_source", "ACCEPTED_OFFER");
        order.put("customer_name_snapshot", user.get("displayName"));
        order.put("customer_phone_snapshot", user.get("phoneNumber"));
        order.put("bakery_name_snapshot", bakery.get("name"));
        order.put("subtotal", source.cakePrice().add(source.addOnTotal()));
        order.put("delivery_fee", source.deliveryFee());
        order.put("total_amount", source.totalPrice());
        order.put("needed_at", Timestamp.from(source.neededAt()));
        insert("customer_orders", order);
        item(
                orderId,
                null,
                "CAKE",
                source.title(),
                source.description(),
                1,
                source.cakePrice(),
                source.cakePrice(),
                source.configuration());
        for (var item : source.items())
            item(
                    orderId,
                    item.id(),
                    "ADD_ON",
                    item.itemNameSnapshot(),
                    item.descriptionSnapshot(),
                    item.quantity(),
                    item.unitPrice(),
                    item.lineTotal(),
                    Map.of());
        Map<String, Object> delivery = new HashMap<>();
        delivery.put("order_id", orderId);
        for (String field :
                List.of(
                        "recipientName",
                        "recipientPhone",
                        "addressLine",
                        "ward",
                        "district",
                        "city",
                        "latitude",
                        "longitude"))
            delivery.put(
                    field.replaceAll("([A-Z])", "_$1").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),
                    address.get(field));
        delivery.put("delivery_note", command.deliveryNote());
        insert("delivery_address_snapshots", delivery);
        insert(
                "order_status_history",
                Map.of(
                        "id",
                        UUID.randomUUID(),
                        "order_id",
                        orderId,
                        "to_status",
                        "PENDING",
                        "changed_by",
                        command.customerId()));
        insert(
                "order_offer_creations",
                Map.of(
                        "idempotency_key",
                        key,
                        "offer_id",
                        command.offerId(),
                        "payload_fingerprint",
                        fingerprint));
        return new OfferOrderService.Creation(
                new OrderCreationResponse(orderId, number, "PENDING"), true);
    }
```

## order-service · OfferOrderRepository.item

Nguồn: [OfferOrderRepository.java:147](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OfferOrderRepository.java#L147). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
private void item(
            UUID orderId,
            UUID sourceId,
            String type,
            String name,
            String description,
            int quantity,
            BigDecimal price,
            BigDecimal total,
            Map<String, Object> configuration)
{
        String snapshot;
        try {
            snapshot = json.writeValueAsString(configuration);
        } catch (Exception error) {
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Invalid configuration snapshot");
        }
        Map<String, Object> values = new HashMap<>();
        values.put("id", UUID.randomUUID());
        values.put("order_id", orderId);
        values.put("source_offer_item_id", sourceId);
        values.put("item_type", type);
        values.put("name_snapshot", name);
        values.put("description_snapshot", description);
        values.put("quantity", quantity);
        values.put("unit_price", price);
        values.put("line_total", total);
        List<String> fields = new ArrayList<>(values.keySet());
        String sql =
                "insert into order_items ("
                        + String.join(",", fields)
                        + ",configuration_snapshot) values ("
                        + fields.stream()
                                .map(f -> ":" + f)
                                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.joining(","))
                        + ",cast(:snapshot as jsonb))";
        jdbc.sql(sql).params(values).param("snapshot", snapshot).update();
    }
```

## order-service · OfferOrderServiceImpl.create

Nguồn: [OfferOrderServiceImpl.java:24](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OfferOrderServiceImpl.java#L24). Kiểu trả về `Creation`.

```java
public Creation create(String key, CreateOfferOrderRequest command)
{
        if (!("accept-offer:" + command.offerId()).equals(key)) throw BusinessException.conflict();
        String fingerprint = fingerprint(command);
        var existing = repository.existing(key, fingerprint, command.offerId());
        if (existing.isPresent()) return new Creation(existing.get(), false);
        var p = http.properties();
        var source =
                http.get(
                        p.marketplaceUrl(),
                        "/internal/v1/offers/" + command.offerId() + "/order-source",
                        "marketplace-service",
                        "marketplace:offer:read",
                        OfferOrderSource.class);
        if (!source.offerId().equals(command.offerId())
                || !source.cakeRequestId().equals(command.cakeRequestId())
                || !source.customerId().equals(command.customerId()))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Offer snapshot mismatch");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> user =
                http.get(
                        p.identityUrl(),
                        "/internal/v1/users/" + command.customerId(),
                        "identity-service",
                        "identity:user:read",
                        Map.class);
        Map<String, Object> address = address(command);
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> bakery =
                http.get(
                        p.bakeryUrl(),
                        "/internal/v1/bakeries/" + source.bakeryId(),
                        "bakery-service",
                        "bakery:profile:read",
                        Map.class);
        if (user.get("phoneNumber") == null
                || !source.deliveryCity().equalsIgnoreCase((String) address.get("city"))
                || !source.deliveryDistrict().equalsIgnoreCase((String) address.get("district")))
            throw BusinessException.invalid("Customer phone/address invalid");
        try {
            return repository.save(key, fingerprint, command, source, user, bakery, address);
        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException concurrent) {
            return new Creation(
                    repository
                            .existing(key, fingerprint, command.offerId())
                            .orElseThrow(BusinessException::conflict),
                    false);
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

Nguồn: [OfferOrderServiceImpl.java:91](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OfferOrderServiceImpl.java#L91). Kiểu trả về `String`.

```java
static String fingerprint(CreateOfferOrderRequest command)
{
        try {
            String note = command.deliveryNote();
            return HexFormat.of()
                    .formatHex(
                            MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                                    .digest(
                                            (command.offerId()
                                                            + "|"
                                                            + command.cakeRequestId()
                                                            + "|"
                                                            + command.customerId()
                                                            + "|"
                                                            + command.deliveryAddressId()
                                                            + "|"
                                                            + (note == null
                                                                    ? "-1:"
                                                                    : note.length() + ":" + note))
                                                    .getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(impossible);
        }
    }
```

## order-service · OrderCreationServiceImpl.createDirectOrder

Nguồn: [OrderCreationServiceImpl.java:49](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderCreationServiceImpl.java#L49). Kiểu trả về `OrderCreationResult`.

```java
@Override
    public OrderCreationResult createDirectOrder(
            UUID customerId, UUID idempotencyKey, CreateDirectOrderRequest request)
{
        requireUuid(customerId, "Authenticated customer ID is required");
        requireUuid(idempotencyKey, "Idempotency-Key is required");
        String payloadHash = fingerprint(request.toString());
        var replay = persistenceService.findReplay(DIRECT_OPERATION, customerId, idempotencyKey, payloadHash);
        if (replay.isPresent()) {
            return replay.get();
        }

        Instant now = clock.instant();
        IdentityClient.UserResponse customer = identityClient.getUser(customerId);
        validateActiveCustomer(customer, customerId);
        IdentityClient.AddressResponse address = identityClient.getAddress(customerId, request.deliveryAddressId());
        validateAddress(address, request.deliveryAddressId());

        BakeryClient.CatalogQuoteRequest quoteRequest = new BakeryClient.CatalogQuoteRequest(
                request.bakeryId(),
                request.productId(),
                request.quantity(),
                toOptionSelections(request.optionSelections()),
                toAddOnSelections(request.addOns()),
                address.district(),
                address.city());
        BakeryClient.CatalogQuoteResponse quote = bakeryClient.getCatalogQuote(quoteRequest);
        validateQuote(quote, request, now);

        CustomerOrder order = CustomerOrder.create(
                customerId,
                quote.bakeryId(),
                null,
                null,
                OrderSource.DIRECT_CATALOG,
                customer.displayName(),
                customer.phoneNumber(),
                quote.bakeryName(),
                request.customerNote(),
                quote.subtotal(),
                quote.deliveryFee(),
                quote.totalAmount(),
                request.requestedDeliveryAt(),
                now);
        addQuoteItems(order, quote, request.productId());
        order.setDeliveryAddressSnapshot(toAddressSnapshot(order, address, null));
        order.addInitialStatusHistory(customerId, now);
        return persistOrReplay(order, DIRECT_OPERATION, customerId, idempotencyKey, payloadHash, now);
    }
```

## order-service · OrderCreationServiceImpl.createFromAcceptedOffer

Nguồn: [OrderCreationServiceImpl.java:98](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderCreationServiceImpl.java#L98). Kiểu trả về `OrderCreationResult`.

```java
@Override
    public OrderCreationResult createFromAcceptedOffer(UUID idempotencyKey, CreateOfferOrderRequest request)
{
        requireUuid(idempotencyKey, "Idempotency-Key is required");
        String payloadHash = fingerprint(request.toString());
        var replay = persistenceService.findReplay(OFFER_OPERATION, request.customerId(), idempotencyKey, payloadHash);
        if (replay.isPresent()) {
            return replay.get();
        }

        MarketplaceClient.AcceptedOfferOrderSourceResponse offer =
                marketplaceClient.getAcceptedOfferOrderSource(request.offerId());
        validateOfferSnapshot(offer, request);
        if (persistenceService.offerAlreadyHasOrder(request.offerId())) {
            throw new OrderConflictException("This offer already has an order");
        }

        Instant now = clock.instant();
        IdentityClient.UserResponse customer = identityClient.getUser(offer.customerId());
        validateActiveCustomer(customer, offer.customerId());
        IdentityClient.AddressResponse address = identityClient.getAddress(
                offer.customerId(), request.deliveryAddressId());
        validateAddress(address, request.deliveryAddressId());
        validateOfferAmounts(offer);
        if (isBlank(offer.customerName()) || isBlank(offer.customerPhone())) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Accepted offer customer snapshot is incomplete");
        }
        if (offer.requestedDeliveryAt() == null || !offer.requestedDeliveryAt().isAfter(now)) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Requested delivery time must be in the future");
        }

        CustomerOrder order = CustomerOrder.create(
                offer.customerId(),
                offer.bakeryId(),
                offer.cakeRequestId(),
                offer.offerId(),
                OrderSource.ACCEPTED_OFFER,
                offer.customerName(),
                offer.customerPhone(),
                offer.bakeryName(),
                null,
                offer.subtotal(),
                offer.deliveryFee(),
                offer.totalAmount(),
                offer.requestedDeliveryAt(),
                now);
        addOfferItems(order, offer.items());
        order.setDeliveryAddressSnapshot(toAddressSnapshot(order, address, request.deliveryNote()));
        order.addInitialStatusHistory(offer.customerId(), now);
        return persistOrReplay(order, OFFER_OPERATION, offer.customerId(), idempotencyKey, payloadHash, now);
    }
```

## order-service · OrderCreationServiceImpl.persistOrReplay

Nguồn: [OrderCreationServiceImpl.java:149](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderCreationServiceImpl.java#L149). Kiểu trả về `OrderCreationResult`.

```java
private OrderCreationResult persistOrReplay(
            CustomerOrder order,
            String operation,
            UUID customerId,
            UUID idempotencyKey,
            String payloadHash,
            Instant now)
{
        try {
            return persistenceService.saveNew(order, operation, customerId, idempotencyKey, payloadHash, now);
        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException exception) {
            return persistenceService.findReplayAfterConflict(operation, customerId, idempotencyKey, payloadHash)
                    .orElseThrow(() -> new OrderConflictException("Order conflicts with an existing order"));
        }
    }
```

## order-service · OrderCreationServiceImpl.validateQuote

Nguồn: [OrderCreationServiceImpl.java:181](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderCreationServiceImpl.java#L181). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
private void validateQuote(BakeryClient.CatalogQuoteResponse quote, CreateDirectOrderRequest request, Instant now)
{
        if (quote == null || !request.bakeryId().equals(quote.bakeryId())
                || !request.productId().equals(quote.productId())
                || quote.expiresAt() == null || !quote.expiresAt().isAfter(now)
                || quote.items() == null || quote.items().isEmpty()) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Bakery quote is invalid or expired");
        }
        if (quote.minimumNoticeHours() < 0
                || request.requestedDeliveryAt().isBefore(now.plusSeconds(quote.minimumNoticeHours() * 3600L))) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Requested delivery time does not meet the minimum notice period");
        }
        for (BakeryClient.QuotedItem item : quote.items()) {
            validateItem(item.name(), item.itemType(), item.quantity(), item.unitPrice(), item.lineTotal());
        }
        validateAmounts(quote.subtotal(), quote.deliveryFee(), quote.totalAmount(), quote.items().stream()
            .map(BakeryClient.QuotedItem::lineTotal).toList());
    }
```

```java
private void validateOfferAmounts(MarketplaceClient.AcceptedOfferOrderSourceResponse offer)
{
        if (offer.items() == null || offer.items().isEmpty()) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Accepted offer must contain at least one item");
        }
        for (MarketplaceClient.OfferItemSnapshot item : offer.items()) {
            validateItem(item.name(), item.itemType(), item.quantity(), item.unitPrice(), item.lineTotal());
        }
        validateAmounts(offer.subtotal(), offer.deliveryFee(), offer.totalAmount(), offer.items().stream()
                .map(MarketplaceClient.OfferItemSnapshot::lineTotal).toList());
    }
```

```java
private void validateItem(String name, String itemType, int quantity, BigDecimal unitPrice, BigDecimal lineTotal)
{
        parseItemType(itemType);
        if (isBlank(name) || quantity <= 0 || unitPrice == null || lineTotal == null
                || unitPrice.signum() < 0 || lineTotal.compareTo(unitPrice.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(quantity))) != 0) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Order item snapshot is invalid");
        }
    }
```

## order-service · OrderCreationServiceImpl.validateAmounts

Nguồn: [OrderCreationServiceImpl.java:228](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderCreationServiceImpl.java#L228). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
private void validateAmounts(
            BigDecimal subtotal, BigDecimal deliveryFee, BigDecimal totalAmount, List<BigDecimal> lineTotals)
{
        if (subtotal == null || deliveryFee == null || totalAmount == null
                || subtotal.signum() < 0 || deliveryFee.signum() < 0
                || totalAmount.compareTo(subtotal.add(deliveryFee)) != 0
                || lineTotals.stream().anyMatch(line -> line == null || line.signum() < 0)) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Order price snapshot is invalid");
        }
        BigDecimal calculatedSubtotal = lineTotals.stream().reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add);
        if (calculatedSubtotal.compareTo(subtotal) != 0) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Order item totals do not match the quoted subtotal");
        }
    }
```

```java
private void addQuoteItems(CustomerOrder order, BakeryClient.CatalogQuoteResponse quote, UUID productId)
{
        if (quote.items() == null || quote.items().isEmpty()) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Bakery quote must contain at least one item");
        }
        for (BakeryClient.QuotedItem item : quote.items()) {
            order.addItem(OrderItem.snapshot(
                    order,
                    "CAKE".equals(item.itemType()) ? productId : null,
                    null,
                    parseItemType(item.itemType()),
                    item.name(),
                    item.description(),
                    item.configuration(),
                    item.quantity(),
                    item.unitPrice(),
                    item.lineTotal()));
        }
    }
```

```java
private void addOfferItems(CustomerOrder order, List<MarketplaceClient.OfferItemSnapshot> items)
{
        if (items == null || items.isEmpty()) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Accepted offer must contain at least one item");
        }
        for (MarketplaceClient.OfferItemSnapshot item : items) {
            order.addItem(OrderItem.snapshot(
                    order,
```

```java
private String fingerprint(String payload)
{
        try {
            byte[] digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(payload.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return java.util.HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest);
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is unavailable", exception);
        }
    }
```

## order-service · OrderManagementServiceImpl.listOrders

Nguồn: [OrderManagementServiceImpl.java:35](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderManagementServiceImpl.java#L35). Kiểu trả về `PageResult<OrderSummaryResponse>`.

```java
@Override
    public PageResult<OrderSummaryResponse> listOrders(
            UUID actorId,
            Set<String> roles,
            String scope,
            UUID bakeryId,
            OrderStatus status,
            OrderSource orderSource,
            Instant createdFrom,
            Instant createdTo,
            int page,
            int size,
            String sort)
{
        if (page < 1 || size < 1 || size > 100) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Pagination values are outside the allowed range");
        }
        if (createdFrom != null && createdTo != null && createdFrom.isAfter(createdTo)) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("createdFrom must not be after createdTo");
        }

        Specification<CustomerOrder> specification = Specification.unrestricted();
        String normalizedScope = hasText(scope) ? scope : "mine";
        switch (normalizedScope) {
            case "mine" -> {
                if (!hasRole(roles, "CUSTOMER") && !hasRole(roles, ADMIN_ROLE)) {
                    throw new OrderAccessDeniedException();
                }
                requireActor(actorId);
                specification = specification.and((root, query, builder) -> builder.equal(root.get("customerId"), actorId));
            }
            case "bakery" -> {
                requireActor(actorId);
                if (bakeryId == null) {
                    throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("bakeryId is required for bakery scope");
                }
                if (!hasRole(roles, ADMIN_ROLE)) {
                    requireBakeryRole(roles);
                    requireActiveMembership(bakeryId, actorId);
                }
                specification = specification.and((root, query, builder) -> builder.equal(root.get("bakeryId"), bakeryId));
            }
            case "all" -> {
                if (!hasRole(roles, ADMIN_ROLE)) {
                    throw new OrderAccessDeniedException();
                }
            }
            default -> throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("scope must be mine, bakery, or all");
        }
        if (status != null) {
            specification = specification.and((root, query, builder) -> builder.equal(root.get("status"), status));
        }
        if (orderSource != null) {
            specification = specification.and((root, query, builder) -> builder.equal(root.get("orderSource"), orderSource));
        }
        if (bakeryId != null && "all".equals(normalizedScope)) {
            specification = specification.and((root, query, builder) -> builder.equal(root.get("bakeryId"), bakeryId));
        }
        if (createdFrom != null) {
            specification = specification.and((root, query, builder) -> builder.greaterThanOrEqualTo(root.get("createdAt"), createdFrom));
        }
        if (createdTo != null) {
            specification = specification.and((root, query, builder) -> builder.lessThanOrEqualTo(root.get("createdAt"), createdTo));
        }

        return persistenceService.list(specification, page, size, parseSort(sort));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## order-service · OrderManagementServiceImpl.transitionOrder

Nguồn: [OrderManagementServiceImpl.java:110](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderManagementServiceImpl.java#L110). Kiểu trả về `OrderResponse`.

```java
@Override
    public OrderResponse transitionOrder(
            UUID orderId, OrderStatus targetStatus, String reason, UUID actorId, Set<String> roles)
{
        requireActor(actorId);
        OrderAuthorizationContext context = persistenceService.getAuthorizationContext(orderId);
        if (hasRole(roles, ADMIN_ROLE)) {
            return persistenceService.transition(orderId, targetStatus, reason, actorId);
        }
        if (hasRole(roles, "CUSTOMER") && context.customerId().equals(actorId)) {
            if (targetStatus != OrderStatus.CANCELLED) {
                throw new OrderAccessDeniedException();
            }
            return persistenceService.transition(orderId, targetStatus, reason, actorId);
        }
        requireBakeryRole(roles);
        requireActiveMembership(context.bakeryId(), actorId);
        return persistenceService.transition(orderId, targetStatus, reason, actorId);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

```java
private void authorizeRead(OrderAuthorizationContext context, UUID actorId, Set<String> roles)
{
        if (hasRole(roles, ADMIN_ROLE)) {
            return;
        }
        if (hasRole(roles, "CUSTOMER") && context.customerId().equals(actorId)) {
            return;
        }
        requireBakeryRole(roles);
        requireActiveMembership(context.bakeryId(), actorId);
    }
```

```java
private void requireActiveMembership(UUID bakeryId, UUID actorId)
{
        BakeryClient.MembershipAuthorizationResponse membership =
                bakeryClient.getMembershipAuthorization(bakeryId, actorId, "OWNER");
        if (membership == null || !membership.active() || !membership.authorized()
                || !"OWNER".equals(membership.memberRole())) {
            throw new OrderAccessDeniedException();
        }
    }
```

## order-service · OrderManagementServiceImpl.parseSort

Nguồn: [OrderManagementServiceImpl.java:170](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderManagementServiceImpl.java#L170). Kiểu trả về `Sort`.

```java
private Sort parseSort(String sort)
{
        String[] parts = sort == null ? new String[0] : sort.split(",", -1);
        if (parts.length != 2) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("sort must use field,asc|desc format");
        }
        String field = parts[0];
        if (!Set.of("createdAt", "neededAt", "totalAmount", "status", "orderNumber").contains(field)) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("sort field is not supported");
        }
        Sort.Direction direction;
        try {
            direction = Sort.Direction.fromString(parts[1]);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("sort direction must be asc or desc");
        }
        return Sort.by(direction, field);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## order-service · OrderPersistenceService.findReplay

Nguồn: [OrderPersistenceService.java:25](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderPersistenceService.java#L25). Kiểu trả về `Optional<OrderCreationResult>`.

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<OrderCreationResult> findReplay(
            String operation, UUID customerId, UUID idempotencyKey, String payloadHash)
{
        return idempotencyRepository
                .findByOperationAndCustomerIdAndIdempotencyKey(operation, customerId, idempotencyKey)
                .map(record -> {
                    if (!record.getPayloadHash().equals(payloadHash)) {
                        throw new OrderConflictException("Idempotency key was already used with a different payload");
                    }
                    return new OrderCreationResult(OrderResponseMapper.toResponse(record.getCustomerOrder()), true);
                });
    }
```

## order-service · OrderPersistenceService.saveNew

Nguồn: [OrderPersistenceService.java:38](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderPersistenceService.java#L38). Kiểu trả về `OrderCreationResult`.

```java
@Transactional
    public OrderCreationResult saveNew(
            CustomerOrder order,
            String operation,
            UUID customerId,
            UUID idempotencyKey,
            String payloadHash,
            Instant now)
{
        if (order.getOfferId() != null && customerOrderRepository.findByOfferId(order.getOfferId()).isPresent()) {
            throw new OrderConflictException("This offer already has an order");
        }
        CustomerOrder savedOrder = customerOrderRepository.saveAndFlush(order);
        idempotencyRepository.saveAndFlush(OrderIdempotencyRecord.create(
                operation, customerId, idempotencyKey, payloadHash, savedOrder, now));
        return new OrderCreationResult(OrderResponseMapper.toResponse(savedOrder), false);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

```java
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
```

## order-service · OrderResponseMapper.toResponse

Nguồn: [OrderResponseMapper.java:14](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/order/OrderResponseMapper.java#L14). Kiểu trả về `OrderResponse`.

```java
public static OrderResponse toResponse(CustomerOrder order)
{
        List<OrderResponse.OrderItemResponse> items = order.getItems().stream()
                .map(item -> new OrderResponse.OrderItemResponse(
                        item.getId(),
                        item.getSourceProductId(),
                        item.getSourceOfferItemId(),
                        item.getItemType().name(),
                        item.getNameSnapshot(),
                        item.getDescriptionSnapshot(),
                        item.getConfigurationSnapshot(),
                        item.getQuantity(),
                        item.getUnitPrice(),
                        item.getLineTotal()))
                .toList();
        DeliveryAddressSnapshot address = order.getDeliveryAddressSnapshot();
        OrderResponse.DeliveryAddressResponse deliveryAddress = address == null ? null
                : new OrderResponse.DeliveryAddressResponse(
                        address.getRecipientName(), address.getRecipientPhone(), address.getAddressLine(),
                        address.getWard(), address.getDistrict(), address.getCity(), address.getLatitude(),
                        address.getLongitude(), address.getDeliveryNote());
        List<OrderResponse.OrderStatusHistoryResponse> history = order.getStatusHistory().stream()
                .map(item -> new OrderResponse.OrderStatusHistoryResponse(
                        item.getFromStatus() == null ? null : item.getFromStatus().name(),
                        item.getToStatus().name(), item.getChangedBy(), item.getNote(), item.getChangedAt()))
                .toList();
        OrderReview review = order.getReview();
        ReviewResponse reviewResponse = review == null ? null : new ReviewResponse(
                review.getId(), review.getCustomerId(), review.getRating(), review.getComment(),
                review.getStatus(), review.getCreatedAt(), review.getUpdatedAt());

        return new OrderResponse(
                order.getId(), order.getOrderNumber(), order.getCustomerId(), order.getBakeryId(),
                order.getCakeRequestId(), order.getOfferId(), order.getOrderSource(),
                order.getCustomerNameSnapshot(), order.getCustomerPhoneSnapshot(), order.getBakeryNameSnapshot(),
                order.getCustomerNote(), order.getSubtotal(), order.getDeliveryFee(), order.getTotalAmount(),
                order.getCurrency(), order.getStatus(), order.getNeededAt(), order.getAcceptedAt(),
                order.getCompletedAt(), order.getCreatedAt(), order.getUpdatedAt(), items,
                deliveryAddress, history, reviewResponse);
    }
```

```java
        status = ReviewStatus.DELETED;
```

```java
void moderate(ReviewStatus targetStatus, Instant now)
{
        if (status == ReviewStatus.DELETED
                || (targetStatus != ReviewStatus.PUBLISHED && targetStatus != ReviewStatus.HIDDEN)
                || status == targetStatus) {
            throw new OrderConflictException("Review status transition is not allowed");
        }
        status = targetStatus;
        updatedAt = now;
    }
```

```java
private UUID requiredActorId(Jwt jwt)
{
        if (jwt == null || jwt.getSubject() == null) {
            throw new OrderAuthenticationRequiredException();
        }
        try {
            return UUID.fromString(jwt.getSubject());
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            throw new OrderAuthenticationRequiredException();
        }
    }
```

## order-service · ReviewServiceImpl.create

Nguồn: [ReviewServiceImpl.java:36](../../../backend/order-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/orderservice/feature/review/ReviewServiceImpl.java#L36). Kiểu trả về `ReviewResponse`.

```java
@Override
    @Transactional
    public ReviewResponse create(UUID orderId, UUID customerId, CreateReviewRequest request)
{
        requireCustomer(customerId);
        CustomerOrder order = orderRepository.findById(orderId).orElseThrow(OrderNotFoundException::new);
        if (!order.getCustomerId().equals(customerId)) {
            throw new OrderNotFoundException();
        }
        if (order.getStatus() != OrderStatus.COMPLETED) {
            throw new InvalidOrderRequestException("Only completed orders can be reviewed");
        }
        if (reviewRepository.existsById(orderId)) {
            throw new OrderConflictException("Order already has a review");
        }
        try {
            OrderReview review = reviewRepository.saveAndFlush(OrderReview.create(
                    order, customerId, (short) request.rating(), request.comment(), clock.instant()));
            return toResponse(review);
        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException exception) {
            throw new OrderConflictException("Order already has a review");
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

<a id="m1705"></a>

```java
@Override
    @Transactional

{
        requireCustomer(customerId);
        OrderReview review = findOwnedReview(orderId, customerId);
        review.update((short) request.rating(), request.comment(), clock.instant());
        return toResponse(reviewRepository.saveAndFlush(review));
    }
```

## platform-support · ServiceHttpClient.exchange

Nguồn: [ServiceHttpClient.java:56](../../../backend/platform-support/src/main/java/com/se193262/platform/client/ServiceHttpClient.java#L56). Kiểu trả về `T`.

```java
private <T> T exchange(
            String base,
            String path,
            String audience,
            String scope,
            Object body,
            String key,
            Class<T> type)
{
        try {
            var request =
                    body == null ? client.get().uri(base + path) : client.post().uri(base + path);
            request.header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token(audience, scope));
            String correlation = org.slf4j.MDC.get("correlationId");
            request.header(
                    "X-Correlation-Id",
                    correlation == null ? UUID.randomUUID().toString() : correlation);
            if (key != null) request.header("Idempotency-Key", key);
            if (body != null) ((RestClient.RequestBodySpec) request).body(body);
            T result = request.retrieve().body(type);
            if (result == null) throw BusinessException.unavailable();
            return result;
        } catch (RestClientResponseException error) {
            int status = error.getStatusCode().value();
            if (status == 404) throw BusinessException.missing();
            if (status == 409) throw BusinessException.conflict();
            if (status == 422 || status == 400)
                throw BusinessException.invalid("Remote validation failed");
            throw BusinessException.unavailable();
        } catch (RestClientException error) {
            throw BusinessException.unavailable();
        }
    }
```

## platform-support · ServiceHttpClient.token

Nguồn: [ServiceHttpClient.java:89](../../../backend/platform-support/src/main/java/com/se193262/platform/client/ServiceHttpClient.java#L89). Kiểu trả về `String`.

```java
private synchronized String token(String audience, String scope)
{
        String cacheKey = audience + ":" + scope;
        Token cached = tokens.get(cacheKey);
        if (cached != null && cached.expiry().isAfter(Instant.now().plusSeconds(30)))
            return cached.value();
        try {
            TokenResponse response =
                    client.post()
                            .uri(properties.identityUrl() + "/internal/v1/auth/service-token")
                            .body(
                                    Map.of(
                                            "clientId",
                                            properties.clientId(),
                                            "clientSecret",
                                            properties.clientSecret(),
                                            "audience",
                                            audience,
                                            "scope",
                                            scope))
                            .retrieve()
                            .body(TokenResponse.class);
            if (response == null
                    || response.accessToken() == null
                    || response.accessToken().isBlank()
                    || response.expiresIn() <= 30) throw BusinessException.unavailable();
            tokens.put(
                    cacheKey,
                    new Token(
                            response.accessToken(),
                            Instant.now().plusSeconds(response.expiresIn())));
            return response.accessToken();
        } catch (RestClientException error) {
            throw BusinessException.unavailable();
        }
    }
```

```java
@Bean
    JwtDecoder jwtDecoder(SecurityProperties properties, RemoteProperties remote)
{
        var factory = new org.springframework.http.client.SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory();
        factory.setConnectTimeout(remote.connectTimeout());
        factory.setReadTimeout(remote.readTimeout());
        var rest = new org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate(factory);
        var decoder = NimbusJwtDecoder.withJwkSetUri(properties.jwkSetUri()).restOperations(rest).jwsAlgorithm(SignatureAlgorithm.RS256).build();
        decoder.setJwtValidator(new DelegatingOAuth2TokenValidator<>(JwtValidators.createDefaultWithIssuer(properties.issuer()), token -> {
            String type = token.getClaimAsString("token_type");
            String audience = "service".equals(type) ? properties.audience() : "user".equals(type) ? properties.userAudience() : null;
            return audience != null && token.getAudience().contains(audience) && token.getSubject() != null ? org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.success() : org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.failure(new org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.OAuth2Error("invalid_token"));
        }));
        return decoder;
    }
```

```java
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain security(HttpSecurity http, ObjectMapper mapper) throws Exception
{
        http.csrf(c -> c.disable()).sessionManagement(s -> s.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS)).authorizeHttpRequests(a -> a.requestMatchers("/actuator/health", "/actuator/health/**").permitAll().requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/v3/api-docs/**", "/v3/api-docs.yaml", "/swagger-ui/**", "/swagger-ui.html").permitAll().requestMatchers("/internal/v1/**").access((authentication, context) -> new AuthorizationDecision(isType(authentication.get(), "service"))).requestMatchers("/api/v1/**").access((authentication, context) -> new AuthorizationDecision(isType(authentication.get(), "user"))).anyRequest().denyAll()).oauth2ResourceServer(o -> o.jwt(j -> j.jwtAuthenticationConverter(token -> {
            List<SimpleGrantedAuthority> authorities = new ArrayList<>();
            if ("user".equals(token.getClaimAsString("token_type"))) {
                List<String> roles = token.getClaimAsStringList("roles");
                if (roles != null) roles.forEach(r -> authorities.add(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + r)));
            } else {
                String scopes = token.getClaimAsString("scope");
                if (scopes != null)
                    Arrays.stream(scopes.split(" ")).filter(s -> !s.isBlank()).forEach(s -> authorities.add(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("SCOPE_" + s)));
            }
            return new JwtAuthenticationToken(token, authorities);
        })).authenticationEntryPoint((request, response, error) -> {
            response.setStatus(401);
            response.setContentType("application/json");
            mapper.writeValue(response.getWriter(), ApiResponse.error(401, "Authentication required"));
        })).exceptionHandling(e -> e.accessDeniedHandler((request, response, error) -> {
            response.setStatus(403);
            response.setContentType("application/json");
            mapper.writeValue(response.getWriter(), ApiResponse.error(403, "Access denied"));
        }));
        return http.build();
    }
```

```java
public static Actor current()
{
        var auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        if (!(auth instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken token)
                || !"user".equals(token.getToken().getClaimAsString("token_type")))
            throw BusinessException.forbidden();

                auth.getAuthorities().stream()
```

```java
@Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(
            HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, FilterChain chain)
            throws ServletException, IOException
{
        String correlation = request.getHeader("X-Correlation-Id");
        try {
            correlation = UUID.fromString(correlation).toString();
        } catch (Exception invalid) {
            correlation = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        }
        response.setHeader("X-Correlation-Id", correlation);
        MDC.put("correlationId", correlation);
        try {
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
        } finally {
            MDC.remove("correlationId");
        }
    }
```

Nguồn: [GlobalExceptionHandler.java:43](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java#L43). Kiểu trả về `ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Map<String, String>>>`.

```java
@ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Map<String, String>>> handleValidation(MethodArgumentNotValidException exception)
{
        Map<String, String> errors = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        exception.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors()
                .forEach(error -> errors.putIfAbsent(error.getField(), error.getDefaultMessage()));
        return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                .body(ApiResponse.of(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(), "Validation failed", errors));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@RestControllerAdvice`

## subscription-service · BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.submit

Nguồn: [BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java:73](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/payment/service/impl/BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java#L73). Kiểu trả về `BakeryPaymentDto`.

```java
@Override
    public BakeryPaymentDto submit(UUID orderId, UUID userId, String idempotencyKey,
                                   BakeryPaymentDto request, MultipartFile proof)
{
        if (request == null || request.id() != null || request.subscriptionOrderId() != null
                || request.submittedByUserId() != null || request.status() != null
                || request.reviewedByAdminId() != null || request.reviewNote() != null
                || request.submittedAt() != null || request.reviewedAt() != null
                || request.proofUrl() != null) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Payment server fields are read-only");
        }
        try { UUID.fromString(idempotencyKey); }
        catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Valid Idempotency-Key UUID is required");
        }
        String requestedMethod = required(request.paymentMethod(), "paymentMethod");
        boolean sandbox = SANDBOX_METHOD.equalsIgnoreCase(requestedMethod);
        String method = sandbox ? SANDBOX_METHOD : requestedMethod;
        boolean hasProof = proof != null && !proof.isEmpty();
        String reference = sandbox
                ? sandboxReference(request.paymentReference(), orderId, idempotencyKey, hasProof)
                : request.paymentReference() == null || request.paymentReference().isBlank()
                        ? null : request.paymentReference().trim();
        if (reference == null && !hasProof) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Payment reference or proof is required");
        }
        if (request.amount() == null || request.amount().signum() <= 0) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "amount must be positive");
        }
        SubscriptionOrder order = orderRepository.findById(orderId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Subscription order not found"));
        bakeryClient.requireMember(order.getBakeryId(), userId, true);
        String hash = hash(orderId + ":" + idempotencyKey);
        boolean retry = paymentRepository.findByIdempotencyKeyHash(hash).isPresent();
        if (!retry) validateOrder(order, request);
        if (retry) return transactions.execute(status -> persistSubmission(orderId, userId,
                request, method, reference, hash, hasProof, null, new AtomicBoolean()));
        String proofKey = hasProof ? proofStorage.upload(proof, orderId) : null;
        AtomicBoolean used = new AtomicBoolean();
        try {
            BakeryPaymentDto response = transactions.execute(status -> persistSubmission(orderId,
                    userId, request, method, reference, hash, hasProof, proofKey, used));
            if (proofKey != null && !used.get()) proofStorage.deleteQuietly(proofKey);
            return response;
        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
            if (proofKey != null) proofStorage.deleteQuietly(proofKey);
            throw exception;
        }
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`
