## subscription-service · BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.sandboxReference

Nguồn: [BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java:122](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/payment/service/impl/BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java#L122). Kiểu trả về `String`.

```java
private String sandboxReference(String code, UUID orderId, String idempotencyKey, boolean hasProof)
{
        if (!isSandboxEnabled()) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Sandbox payments are disabled");
        }
        if (!sandboxCode.equals(code) || hasProof) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Invalid sandbox payment code or proof");
        }
        // The reusable test code is not a unique transaction reference and must not be stored.
        return SANDBOX_METHOD + "-" + orderId + "-" + idempotencyKey;
    }
```

## subscription-service · BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.persistSubmission

Nguồn: [BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java:133](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/payment/service/impl/BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java#L133). Kiểu trả về `BakeryPaymentDto`.

```java
private BakeryPaymentDto persistSubmission(UUID orderId, UUID userId,
            BakeryPaymentDto request, String method, String reference, String hash,
            boolean hasProof, String proofKey, AtomicBoolean used)
{
        BakeryPayment existing = paymentRepository.findByIdempotencyKeyHash(hash).orElse(null);
        if (existing != null) {
            if (!existing.getOrder().getId().equals(orderId)
                    || !existing.getSubmittedByUserId().equals(userId)
                    || !existing.getPaymentMethod().equals(method)
                    || !java.util.Objects.equals(existing.getPaymentReference(), reference)
                    || existing.getAmount().compareTo(request.amount()) != 0
                    || !existing.getCurrency().equals(request.currency())
                    || (hasProof && existing.getProofObjectKey() == null)) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Idempotency-Key was used with different payment data");
            }
            return toDto(existing);
        }
        SubscriptionOrder order = orderRepository.findById(orderId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Subscription order not found"));
        validateOrder(order, request);
        if (reference != null && paymentRepository.findByPaymentReference(reference).isPresent()) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Payment reference already exists");
        }
        BakeryPayment payment = new BakeryPayment(order, userId, method, reference, hash,
                request.amount(), request.currency(), proofKey);
        order.submitPayment();
        BakeryPayment saved = paymentRepository.saveAndFlush(payment);
        orderRepository.flush();
        used.set(true);
        return toDto(saved);
    }
```

## subscription-service · BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.validateOrder

Nguồn: [BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java:164](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/payment/service/impl/BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java#L164). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
private void validateOrder(SubscriptionOrder order, BakeryPaymentDto request)
{
        if (order.getStatus() != SubscriptionOrderStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT
                || !order.getExpiresAt().isAfter(Instant.now())) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Order is not awaiting payment");
        }
        if (order.getTotalAmount().compareTo(request.amount()) != 0
                || !order.getCurrency().equals(request.currency())) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Payment amount or currency differs from order");
        }
    }
```

## subscription-service · BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.listForReview

Nguồn: [BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java:175](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/payment/service/impl/BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java#L175). Kiểu trả về `PageResult<BakeryPaymentDto>`.

```java
@Override @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResult<BakeryPaymentDto> listForReview(PaymentStatus status, UUID bakeryId,
            Instant submittedFrom, Instant submittedTo, int page, int size, String sort)
{
        if (page < 1 || size < 1 || size > 100
                || (submittedFrom != null && submittedTo != null && submittedFrom.isAfter(submittedTo))) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid pagination or submitted date range");
        }
        Specification<BakeryPayment> filter = (root, query, builder) -> {
            List<jakarta.persistence.criteria.Predicate> predicates = new ArrayList<>();
            if (status != null) predicates.add(builder.equal(root.get("status"), status));
            if (bakeryId != null) predicates.add(builder.equal(root.get("order").get("bakeryId"), bakeryId));
            if (submittedFrom != null) predicates.add(builder.greaterThanOrEqualTo(root.get("submittedAt"), submittedFrom));
            if (submittedTo != null) predicates.add(builder.lessThanOrEqualTo(root.get("submittedAt"), submittedTo));
            return builder.and(predicates.toArray(jakarta.persistence.criteria.Predicate[]::new));
        };
        Sort.Direction direction = switch (sort) {
            case "submittedAt,asc" -> Sort.Direction.ASC;
            case "submittedAt,desc" -> Sort.Direction.DESC;
            default -> throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid payment sort");
        };
        return PageResult.fromPage(paymentRepository.findAll(filter,
                PageRequest.of(page - 1, size, Sort.by(direction, "submittedAt")))
                .map(this::toDto));
    }
```

```java
@Override
    public PaymentReviewResponse approve(UUID paymentId, UUID adminId, String idempotencyKey,
            String reviewNote)
{
        String keyHash = reviewKey(idempotencyKey);
        PaymentReviewResponse result = transactions.execute(status -> approveInTransaction(
                paymentId, adminId, keyHash, reviewNote));
        bakeryClient.notifySubscriptionApproved(result.order().bakeryId());
        return result;
    }
```

## subscription-service · BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.approveInTransaction

Nguồn: [BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java:210](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/payment/service/impl/BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java#L210). Kiểu trả về `PaymentReviewResponse`.

```java
private PaymentReviewResponse approveInTransaction(UUID paymentId, UUID adminId, String keyHash,
            String reviewNote)
{
        BakeryPayment payment = paymentRepository.findById(paymentId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Payment not found"));
        SubscriptionOrder order = payment.getOrder();
        if (payment.getStatus() == PaymentStatus.APPROVED
                && keyHash.equals(payment.getReviewIdempotencyKeyHash())
                && adminId.equals(payment.getReviewedByAdminId())
                && java.util.Objects.equals(reviewNote, payment.getReviewNote())) {
            BakerySubscription existing = subscriptionRepository.findBySourceOrder_Id(order.getId())
                    .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Approved period is missing"));
            return reviewResponse(payment, order, existing);
        }
        if (payment.getStatus() != PaymentStatus.SUBMITTED
                || order.getStatus() != SubscriptionOrderStatus.PAYMENT_REVIEW) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Payment is not awaiting review");
        }
        if (order.getTotalAmount().compareTo(payment.getAmount()) != 0
                || !order.getCurrency().equals(payment.getCurrency())) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Payment differs from order");
        }
        if (!subscriptionRepository.tryLockBakery(order.getBakeryId())) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Another subscription approval is in progress");
        }
        if (subscriptionRepository.findBySourceOrder_Id(order.getId()).isPresent()) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Order already has a subscription period");
        }
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        subscriptionRepository.findAllByBakeryIdOrderByPeriodStartDesc(order.getBakeryId())
                .stream().filter(period -> period.getStatus() == SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE
                        && !period.getPeriodEnd().isAfter(now))
                .forEach(BakerySubscription::expire);
        subscriptionRepository.flush();
        Instant start = subscriptionRepository.findAllByBakeryIdOrderByPeriodStartDesc(order.getBakeryId())
                .stream().filter(period -> period.getStatus() == SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE
                        || period.getStatus() == SubscriptionStatus.SCHEDULED)
                .map(BakerySubscription::getPeriodEnd).filter(end -> end.isAfter(now))
                .max(Instant::compareTo).orElse(now);
        Instant end = start.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).plusMonths(order.getBillingPeriodMonths()).toInstant();
        if (!end.isAfter(start)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Invalid subscription period");
        }
        BakerySubscription period = new BakerySubscription(order, start, end, now);
        payment.approve(adminId, reviewNote, keyHash, now);
        order.complete(now);
        subscriptionRepository.saveAndFlush(period);
        paymentRepository.flush();
        orderRepository.flush();
        return reviewResponse(payment, order, period);
    }
```

## subscription-service · BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.reject

Nguồn: [BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java:261](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/payment/service/impl/BakeryPaymentServiceImpl.java#L261). Kiểu trả về `PaymentReviewResponse`.

```java
@Override @Transactional
    public PaymentReviewResponse reject(UUID paymentId, UUID adminId, String reviewNote)
{
        if (reviewNote == null || reviewNote.isBlank()) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "reviewNote is required");
        }
        BakeryPayment payment = paymentRepository.findById(paymentId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Payment not found"));
        SubscriptionOrder order = payment.getOrder();
        if (payment.getStatus() != PaymentStatus.SUBMITTED
                || order.getStatus() != SubscriptionOrderStatus.PAYMENT_REVIEW) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Payment is not awaiting review");
        }
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        payment.reject(adminId, reviewNote.trim(), now);
        order.rejectPayment(now);
        paymentRepository.flush();
        orderRepository.flush();
        return reviewResponse(payment, order, null);
    }
```

```java
private static String hash(String value)
{
        try {
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                    .digest(value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is unavailable", exception);
        }
    }
```

```java
public void update(String code, String name, String description, BigDecimal monthlyPrice,
                       String currency, Integer billingPeriodMonths, PlanStatus status,
                       Map<String, String> features)
{
        if (code != null) this.code = code;
        if (name != null) this.name = name;
        if (description != null) this.description = description;
        if (monthlyPrice != null) this.monthlyPrice = monthlyPrice;
        if (currency != null) this.currency = currency;
        if (billingPeriodMonths != null) this.billingPeriodMonths = billingPeriodMonths;
        if (status != null) this.status = status;
        if (features != null) {
            this.features.clear();
            this.features.putAll(features);
        }
    }
```

## subscription-service · SubscriptionPlanServiceImpl.create

Nguồn: [SubscriptionPlanServiceImpl.java:49](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/plan/service/impl/SubscriptionPlanServiceImpl.java#L49). Kiểu trả về `SubscriptionPlanDto`.

```java
@Override @Transactional
    public SubscriptionPlanDto create(SubscriptionPlanDto request)
{
        if (request == null || request.id() != null) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "id is read-only");
        }
        String code = required(request.code(), "code").toUpperCase();
        if (planRepository.existsByCode(code)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Plan code already exists");
        }
        String name = required(request.name(), "name");
        BigDecimal price = price(request.monthlyPrice());
        int period = period(request.billingPeriodMonths());
        String currency = currency(request.currency());
        validateFeatures(request.features());
        SubscriptionPlan plan = new SubscriptionPlan(code, name, price);
        plan.update(null, null, request.description(), null, currency, period,
                request.status(), request.features() == null ? Map.of() : request.features());
        return SubscriptionPlanDto.fromEntity(planRepository.saveAndFlush(plan));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

<a id="m1906"></a>

## subscription-service · SubscriptionPlanServiceImpl.update

Nguồn: [SubscriptionPlanServiceImpl.java:69](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/plan/service/impl/SubscriptionPlanServiceImpl.java#L69). Kiểu trả về `SubscriptionPlanDto`.

```java
@Override @Transactional
    public SubscriptionPlanDto update(UUID planId, SubscriptionPlanDto request)
{
        if (request == null || request.id() != null) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "id is read-only");
        }
        SubscriptionPlan plan = findPlan(planId);
        String code = request.code() == null ? null : required(request.code(), "code").toUpperCase();
        if (code != null && !code.equals(plan.getCode())) {
            if (orderRepository.existsByPlan_Id(planId)) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Plan code cannot change after an order exists");
            }
            if (planRepository.existsByCodeAndIdNot(code, planId)) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Plan code already exists");
            }
        }
        validateFeatures(request.features());
        plan.update(code, request.name() == null ? null : required(request.name(), "name"),
                request.description(), request.monthlyPrice() == null ? null : price(request.monthlyPrice()),
                request.currency() == null ? null : currency(request.currency()),
                request.billingPeriodMonths() == null ? null : period(request.billingPeriodMonths()),
                request.status(), request.features());
        planRepository.flush();
        return SubscriptionPlanDto.fromEntity(plan);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

```java
    public SubscriptionPlanDto archive(UUID planId)
{
        SubscriptionPlan plan = findPlan(planId);
        if (plan.getStatus() == PlanStatus.ARCHIVED) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Plan is already archived");

        return SubscriptionPlanDto.fromEntity(plan);
```

## subscription-service · SubscriptionPlanServiceImpl.validateFeatures

Nguồn: [SubscriptionPlanServiceImpl.java:138](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/plan/service/impl/SubscriptionPlanServiceImpl.java#L138). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
private static void validateFeatures(Map<String, String> features)
{
        if (features == null) return;
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> feature : features.entrySet()) {
            if (feature.getKey() == null || feature.getKey().isBlank() || feature.getKey().length() > 80
                    || feature.getValue() == null || feature.getValue().isBlank()
                    || feature.getValue().length() > 255) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Invalid plan feature");
            }
        }
    }
```

<a id="m1954"></a>

## subscription-service · BakerySubscriptionServiceImpl.getForBakery

Nguồn: [BakerySubscriptionServiceImpl.java:45](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/subscription/service/impl/BakerySubscriptionServiceImpl.java#L45). Kiểu trả về `BakerySubscriptionDto`.

```java
@Override @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public BakerySubscriptionDto getForBakery(UUID bakeryId)
{
        List<BakerySubscription> periods = subscriptionRepository
                .findAllByBakeryIdAndStatusInOrderByPeriodStartAsc(bakeryId,
                        List.of(SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE, SubscriptionStatus.SCHEDULED));
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        BakerySubscription current = periods.stream()
                .filter(period -> period.getStatus() == SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE
                        && !period.getPeriodStart().isAfter(now) && period.getPeriodEnd().isAfter(now))
                .findFirst().orElse(null);
        BakerySubscription scheduled = periods.stream()
                .filter(period -> period.getStatus() == SubscriptionStatus.SCHEDULED
                        && period.getPeriodStart().isAfter(now))
                .findFirst().orElse(null);
        return new BakerySubscriptionDto(bakeryId,
                current == null ? null : BakerySubscriptionDto.Period.fromEntity(current),
                scheduled == null ? null : BakerySubscriptionDto.Period.fromEntity(scheduled),
                current == null ? Map.of() : Map.copyOf(current.getFeaturesSnapshot()));
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

```java
public static SubscriptionOrderDto fromEntity(SubscriptionOrder order,
```

```java
            java.util.function.Function<BakeryPayment, String> proofUrl)
{

                order.getPlan().getId(), order.getRequestedByUserId(), order.getPlanNameSnapshot(),
                order.getPlanCodeSnapshot(), Map.copyOf(order.getFeaturesSnapshot()),
                order.getBillingPeriodMonths(), order.getTotalAmount(), order.getCurrency(),
                order.getStatus(), order.getExpiresAt(), order.getCompletedAt(), order.getCreatedAt(),
                payments.stream().map(payment -> PaymentSummary.fromEntity(payment,

                period == null ? null : PeriodSummary.fromEntity(period));
```

## subscription-service · SubscriptionOrderServiceImpl.createInTransaction

Nguồn: [SubscriptionOrderServiceImpl.java:67](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/subscriptionorder/service/impl/SubscriptionOrderServiceImpl.java#L67). Kiểu trả về `SubscriptionOrderDto`.

```java
private SubscriptionOrderDto createInTransaction(UUID bakeryId, UUID userId,
            String idempotencyKey, SubscriptionOrderDto request)
{
        if (request == null || request.planId() == null || request.id() != null
                || request.orderNumber() != null || request.bakeryId() != null
                || request.requestedByUserId() != null || request.planNameSnapshot() != null
                || request.planCodeSnapshot() != null || request.featuresSnapshot() != null
                || request.billingPeriodMonths() != null || request.totalAmount() != null
                || request.currency() != null || request.status() != null
                || request.expiresAt() != null || request.completedAt() != null
                || request.createdAt() != null || request.payments() != null || request.period() != null) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Only planId is allowed in request body");
        }
        try { UUID.fromString(idempotencyKey); }
        catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Valid Idempotency-Key UUID is required");
        }
        String orderNumber = orderNumber(bakeryId, idempotencyKey);
        // Serialize creation and approval for this bakery across application instances.
        if (!subscriptionRepository.tryLockBakery(bakeryId)) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Another subscription operation is in progress");
        }
        SubscriptionOrder existing = orderRepository.findByOrderNumber(orderNumber).orElse(null);
        if (existing != null) {
            if (!existing.getBakeryId().equals(bakeryId)
                    || !existing.getRequestedByUserId().equals(userId)
                    || !existing.getPlan().getId().equals(request.planId())) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Idempotency-Key was used with different order data");
            }
            return details(existing, userId);
        }
        if (orderRepository.existsByBakeryIdAndStatus(bakeryId, SubscriptionOrderStatus.PAYMENT_REVIEW)
                || orderRepository.existsByBakeryIdAndStatusInAndExpiresAtAfter(bakeryId,
                List.of(SubscriptionOrderStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT), Instant.now())) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Bakery already has an open subscription order");
        }
        SubscriptionPlan plan = planRepository.findById(request.planId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Plan not found"));
        if (plan.getStatus() != PlanStatus.ACTIVE) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "Plan is not active");
        }
        SubscriptionOrder order = new SubscriptionOrder(orderNumber, bakeryId, plan, userId,
                Instant.now().plus(expiryHours, ChronoUnit.HOURS));
        return details(orderRepository.saveAndFlush(order), userId);
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Service`

## subscription-service · SubscriptionOrderServiceImpl.list

Nguồn: [SubscriptionOrderServiceImpl.java:112](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/subscriptionorder/service/impl/SubscriptionOrderServiceImpl.java#L112). Kiểu trả về `PageResult<SubscriptionOrderDto>`.

```java
@Override @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public PageResult<SubscriptionOrderDto> list(UUID bakeryId, UUID userId, boolean admin,
            SubscriptionOrderStatus status, int page, int size, String sort)
{
        if (admin) bakeryClient.requireBakery(bakeryId);
        else bakeryClient.requireMember(bakeryId, userId, false);
        if (page < 1 || size < 1 || size > 100) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "page must be >= 1 and size must be 1..100");
        }
        Sort.Direction direction = switch (sort) {
            case "createdAt,desc" -> Sort.Direction.DESC;
            case "createdAt,asc" -> Sort.Direction.ASC;
            default -> throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid order sort");
        };
        PageRequest pageable = PageRequest.of(page - 1, size, Sort.by(direction, "createdAt"));
        var orders = status == null
                ? orderRepository.findAllByBakeryId(bakeryId, pageable)
                : orderRepository.findAllByBakeryIdAndStatus(bakeryId, status, pageable);
        return PageResult.fromPage(orders.map(order ->
                SubscriptionOrderDto.fromEntity(order, List.of(), null)));
    }
```

```java
    public SubscriptionOrderDto get(UUID orderId, UUID userId, boolean admin)
{
        SubscriptionOrder order = orderRepository.findById(orderId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Subscription order not found"));
        if (!admin) bakeryClient.requireMember(order.getBakeryId(), userId, false);
        return details(order, admin ? null : userId);
```

```java
                paymentRepository.findAllByOrder_IdOrderBySubmittedAtAsc(order.getId()),
                subscriptionRepository.findBySourceOrder_Id(order.getId()).orElse(null),

                        ? proofStorage.signedUrl(payment.getProofObjectKey()) : null);
```

## subscription-service · SubscriptionOrderServiceImpl.orderNumber

Nguồn: [SubscriptionOrderServiceImpl.java:149](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/feature/subscriptionorder/service/impl/SubscriptionOrderServiceImpl.java#L149). Kiểu trả về `String`.

```java
private static String orderNumber(UUID bakeryId, String idempotencyKey)
{
        try {
            byte[] digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(
                    (bakeryId + ":" + idempotencyKey).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return "SUB-" + HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest).substring(0, 36);
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is unavailable", exception);
        }
    }
```

```java
public BakeryAccessClient(@Value("${clients.bakery.url:http://localhost:8082}") String baseUrl,
            @Value("${clients.bakery.service-token:}") String serviceToken,
            ServiceHttpClient tokenClient)
{
        this.serviceToken = serviceToken;
        this.tokenClient = tokenClient;
        JdkClientHttpRequestFactory factory = new JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(
                HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).build());
        factory.setReadTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(3));
        this.client = RestClient.builder().baseUrl(baseUrl).requestFactory(factory).build();
    }
```

## subscription-service · BakeryAccessClient.notifySubscriptionApproved

Nguồn: [BakeryAccessClient.java:44](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/infrastructure/client/BakeryAccessClient.java#L44). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
public void notifySubscriptionApproved(UUID bakeryId)
{
        try {
            String bearer = tokenClient.serviceToken("bakery-service", "bakery:onboarding:activate");
            client.put().uri("/internal/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/onboarding/activate", bakeryId)
                    .headers(headers -> {
                        headers.setBearerAuth(bearer);
                        headers.set("X-Correlation-Id", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
                    })
                    .retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
        } catch (RestClientException | com.se193262.platform.exception.AppException failure) {
            log.warn("Bakery activation notification for {} failed ({}). Bakery will retry activation.",
                    bakeryId, failure.getClass().getSimpleName());
        }
    }
```

```java
public void requireMember(UUID bakeryId, UUID userId, boolean ownerRequired)
{
        Authorization response = call(ownerRequired
                        ? "/internal/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/members/{userId}/authorization?requiredRole=OWNER"
                        : "/internal/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/members/{userId}/authorization",
                Authorization.class, bakeryId, userId);
        if (response == null || !bakeryId.equals(response.bakeryId())
                || !userId.equals(response.userId())) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Invalid Bakery authorization response");
        }
        if (!response.active() || !response.authorized()
                || !"OWNER".equals(response.memberRole())) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Bakery membership is required");
        }
    }
```

## subscription-service · BakeryAccessClient.call

Nguồn: [BakeryAccessClient.java:74](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/infrastructure/client/BakeryAccessClient.java#L74). Kiểu trả về `T`.

```java
private <T> T call(String path, Class<T> type, Object... variables)
{
        try {
            String bearer = serviceToken.isBlank() ? tokenClient.serviceToken("bakery-service",
                    "bakery:profile:read bakery:membership:read") : serviceToken;
            T response = client.get().uri(path, variables).headers(headers -> {
                headers.setBearerAuth(bearer);
                headers.set("X-Correlation-Id", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
            }).retrieve().body(type);
            if (response == null) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Empty Bakery service response");
            }
            return response;
        } catch (com.se193262.platform.exception.AppException exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Bakery service credential is unavailable");
        } catch (RestClientResponseException exception) {
            if (exception.getStatusCode().value() == 404) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Bakery not found");
            }
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Bakery validation is unavailable");
        } catch (RestClientException exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Bakery validation is unavailable");
        }
    }
```

## subscription-service · SubscriptionLifecycleJob.reconcile

Nguồn: [SubscriptionLifecycleJob.java:24](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/infrastructure/scheduler/SubscriptionLifecycleJob.java#L24). Kiểu trả về `void`.

```java
@Scheduled(fixedDelayString = "${subscription.lifecycle-interval-ms:60000}")
    @Transactional
    public void reconcile()
{
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        orders.findAllByStatusAndExpiresAtLessThanEqual(SubscriptionOrderStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT, now)
                .forEach(order -> order.expire());
        subscriptions.findAllByStatusAndPeriodEndLessThanEqual(SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE, now)
                .forEach(period -> period.expire());
        subscriptions.flush();
        subscriptions.findAllByStatusAndPeriodStartLessThanEqual(SubscriptionStatus.SCHEDULED, now)
                .forEach(period -> {
                    if (!period.getPeriodEnd().isAfter(now)) period.expire();
                    else period.activate(now);
                });
        subscriptions.flush();
        orders.flush();
    }
```

## subscription-service · PaymentProofStorage.upload

Nguồn: [PaymentProofStorage.java:50](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/infrastructure/storage/PaymentProofStorage.java#L50). Kiểu trả về `String`.

```java
public String upload(MultipartFile file, UUID orderId)
{
        if (file == null || file.isEmpty() || file.getSize() > MAX_BYTES) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Proof must be between 1 byte and 10 MB");
        }
        try {
            byte[] bytes = file.getBytes();
            if (bytes.length == 0 || bytes.length > MAX_BYTES) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Proof must be between 1 byte and 10 MB");
            }
            String type = detect(bytes);
            String declared = file.getContentType() == null ? "" : file.getContentType().split(";", 2)[0].trim();
            if (type == null || !type.equalsIgnoreCase(declared)) {
                throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Unsupported proof or content type mismatch");
            }
            String key = "payments/" + orderId + "/" + UUID.randomUUID();
            MinioClient storage = client(endpoint);
            if (!storage.bucketExists(BucketExistsArgs.builder().bucket(bucket).build())) {
                storage.makeBucket(MakeBucketArgs.builder().bucket(bucket).build());
            }
            storage.putObject(PutObjectArgs.builder().bucket(bucket).object(key)
                    .stream(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes), bytes.length, -1).contentType(type).build());
            if (TransactionSynchronizationManager.isSynchronizationActive()) {
                TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(new TransactionSynchronization() {
                    @Override public void afterCompletion(int status) {
                        if (status != STATUS_COMMITTED) deleteQuietly(key);
                    }
                });
            }
            return key;
        } catch (AppException exception) {
            throw exception;
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Proof could not be read");
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Proof storage is unavailable");
        }
    }
```

```java
public String signedUrl(String key)
{
        if (key == null) return null;
        try {
            // The browser URL can be unreachable from Docker; sign without a region lookup.
            return client(publicEndpoint.isBlank() ? endpoint : publicEndpoint)
                    .getPresignedObjectUrl(GetPresignedObjectUrlArgs.builder()
                            .method(Method.GET).region(region).bucket(bucket).object(key)
                            .expiry(15, TimeUnit.MINUTES).build());
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new AppException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Proof storage is unavailable");
        }
    }
```

## subscription-service · PaymentProofStorage.detect

Nguồn: [PaymentProofStorage.java:113](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/infrastructure/storage/PaymentProofStorage.java#L113). Kiểu trả về `String`.

```java
private static String detect(byte[] bytes)
{
        if (bytes.length >= 3 && (bytes[0] & 255) == 255 && (bytes[1] & 255) == 216
                && (bytes[2] & 255) == 255) return "image/jpeg";
        if (bytes.length >= 8 && (bytes[0] & 255) == 137 && bytes[1] == 'P'
                && bytes[2] == 'N' && bytes[3] == 'G' && bytes[4] == 13
                && bytes[5] == 10 && bytes[6] == 26 && bytes[7] == 10) return "image/png";
        if (bytes.length >= 12 && bytes[0] == 'R' && bytes[1] == 'I' && bytes[2] == 'F'
                && bytes[3] == 'F' && bytes[8] == 'W' && bytes[9] == 'E'
                && bytes[10] == 'B' && bytes[11] == 'P') return "image/webp";
        if (bytes.length >= 5 && bytes[0] == '%' && bytes[1] == 'P'
                && bytes[2] == 'D' && bytes[3] == 'F' && bytes[4] == '-') return "application/pdf";
        return null;
    }
```

## subscription-service · JwtDecoderConfig.jwtDecoder

Nguồn: [JwtDecoderConfig.java:21](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/security/JwtDecoderConfig.java#L21). Kiểu trả về `JwtDecoder`.

```java
@Bean
    @ConditionalOnMissingBean(JwtDecoder.class)
    JwtDecoder jwtDecoder(
            @Value("${spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.jwk-set-uri}") String jwksUri,
            @Value("${spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri}") String issuer,
            @Value("${security.jwt.user-audience:bakery-platform-api}") String userAudience,
            @Value("${security.jwt.service-audience:subscription-service}") String serviceAudience)
{
        NimbusJwtDecoder decoder = NimbusJwtDecoder.withJwkSetUri(jwksUri)
                .jwsAlgorithm(SignatureAlgorithm.RS256).build();
        OAuth2TokenValidator<Jwt> audience = jwt -> {
            String type = jwt.getClaimAsString("token_type");
            String expected = "user".equals(type) ? userAudience
                    : "service".equals(type) ? serviceAudience : null;
            return expected != null && jwt.getAudience().contains(expected)
                    ? OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.success()
                    : OAuth2TokenValidatorResult.failure(new OAuth2Error("invalid_token",
                            "Invalid token type or audience", null));
        };
        decoder.setJwtValidator(new DelegatingOAuth2TokenValidator<>(
                new JwtTimestampValidator(), new JwtIssuerValidator(issuer), audience,
                new JwtClaimValidator<String>("sub", subject -> subject != null && !subject.isBlank())));
        return decoder;
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`

## subscription-service · SecurityConfig.securityFilterChain

Nguồn: [SecurityConfig.java:39](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/security/SecurityConfig.java#L39). Kiểu trả về `SecurityFilterChain`.

```java
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http,
            JwtAuthenticationConverter jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler) throws Exception
{
        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .sessionManagement(session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(authorize -> authorize
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/v3/api-docs/**", "/swagger-ui/**", "/swagger-ui.html")
                        .permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,
                                "/internal/v1/subscriptions/bakeries/{bakeryId}/entitlement")
                        .access(serviceScope("subscription:entitlement:read"))
                        .requestMatchers("/internal/v1/**").denyAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,
                                "/api/v1/subscription-plans",
                                "/api/v1/subscription-plans/{planId}")
                        .permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/admin/**").access(userRole("ADMIN"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/subscription-orders",
                                "/api/v1/subscription-orders/{orderId}/payments")
                        .access(userRole("BAKERY_OWNER", "CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/subscription",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/subscription-orders",
                                "/api/v1/subscription-orders/{orderId}")
                        .access(userRole("BAKERY_OWNER", "CUSTOMER", "ADMIN"))
                        .anyRequest().denyAll())
                .oauth2ResourceServer(resourceServer -> resourceServer
                        .jwt(jwt -> jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(jwtAuthenticationConverter))
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler))
                .exceptionHandling(exceptions -> exceptions
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler));
        return http.build();
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`

## subscription-service · SecurityConfig.userRole

Nguồn: [SecurityConfig.java:89](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/security/SecurityConfig.java#L89). Kiểu trả về `AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext>`.

```java
private AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext> userRole(String... roles)
{
        return (authentication, context) -> {
            Authentication resolved = authentication.get();
            boolean allowed = resolved instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken jwtAuthentication
                    && resolved.isAuthenticated()
                    && "user".equals(jwtAuthentication.getToken().getClaimAsString("token_type"))
                    && isUuid(jwtAuthentication.getToken().getSubject())
                    && Arrays.stream(roles).anyMatch(role -> resolved.getAuthorities().stream()
                            .anyMatch(authority -> ("ROLE_" + role).equals(authority.getAuthority())));
            return new AuthorizationDecision(allowed);
        };
    }
```

## subscription-service · SecurityConfig.serviceScope

Nguồn: [SecurityConfig.java:102](../../../backend/subscription-service/src/main/java/com/se193262/subscriptionservice/security/SecurityConfig.java#L102). Kiểu trả về `AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext>`.

```java
private AuthorizationManager<RequestAuthorizationContext> serviceScope(String scope)
{
        return (authentication, context) -> {
            Authentication resolved = authentication.get();
            if (!(resolved instanceof JwtAuthenticationToken token) || !resolved.isAuthenticated()) {
                return new AuthorizationDecision(false);
            }
            String correlationId = context.getRequest().getHeader("X-Correlation-Id");
            String scopes = token.getToken().getClaimAsString("scope");
            return new AuthorizationDecision("service".equals(token.getToken().getClaimAsString("token_type"))
                    && token.getToken().getAudience().contains(serviceAudience)
                    && correlationId != null && !correlationId.isBlank()
                    && scopes != null && Arrays.asList(scopes.split(" ")).contains(scope));
        };
    }
```

Annotation class: `@Configuration`, `@EnableWebSecurity`, `@EnableMethodSecurity`

```java
private boolean isUuid(String value)
{
        if (value == null) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            UUID.fromString(value);
            return true;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            return false;
        }
    }
```

```java
@Bean
    AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint(ObjectMapper objectMapper)
{
        return (request, response, exception) -> {
            response.setStatus(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED.value());
            response.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE);
            response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
            objectMapper.writeValue(response.getWriter(),
                    ApiResponse.error(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED.value(), "Authentication is required or token is invalid"));
        };
    }
```
